notes.title: System Update: Fair Play System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/39d2856b51773a51a03e3ca4a8911bb98dd6d0a0.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City 

The followings are the updates for the end of this month. 

[b][System] 
[/b]
[h3][b]1. Fair Play System [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9a9bf640ca064a74e87e6cfa3278a2bc385acf87.png[/img]

Manner makes a good player! Reward for good player and penalty for bad manner!

Fair Play System is now implement to enhance your sportsmanship!

Let’s check how it works!

[b]1. Fair Play Grade [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a99fe3a3c53e07cb14ebefa97b82dc208c05438f.png[/img]

-Based on your Fair Play Score 4 different grade is applied.

-Grade 4 (Score 0~59) : Your Coin/EXP reward is 50% decreased. You cannot participate any Ranked Mode.

-Grade 3 (Score 60~79) : Your Coin/EXP reward is 25% decreased.

-Grade 2 (Score 80~89) : Basie level. Neither penalty nor reward is applied.

-Grade 1 (Score 90~100) : You can get extra reward after playing certain matches.

-Fair Play System is applied to following modes; 1vs1, 3vs3, Ranked Mode, 3x3, Astro Buff Rank, Joycity Cup

[b]2) Fair Play Score[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ea0636b77feb77a3fa7703bb9c944b0c78c1d361.png[/img]

-You can acquire Fair Play Score by completing following activities:

*Complete your match without any bad behavior (DC, AFK, and Macro Spam)

*Get MVP for your match

-You will lose Fair Play Score if you doing following bad behaviors:

*Spamming macro chat
*Intentional quit / disconnection
*Away from keyboard
*Get vote kick

-There is limit in getting Fair Play Score. Once you hit maximum amount for day, you cannot get extra Fair Play Score. The limit will reset at everyday 00:00 PST

-There is no limit in losing Fair Play Score. If you keep doing bad behavior, your Fair Play Score will go down without limitation.

-If you get multiple warnings for same category, you will lose double scores. For example, if you get 3 macro chat spamming alert, you will lose x3 Fair Play Score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6c870ecbfd80f8b60349dd57dd7e936596dd2c38.png[/img]

-You can see your Fair Play Score change on result page. If you would like to see the detail, press [Fair Play Log] button.

With the update of Fair Play System, current penalty system will be removed

[h3][b]2. New Intensive Character; Big Joe[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9e1e7d2ec0fb0fed10dce19facfc5b6bd71213ea.png[/img]

Big Joe’s Intensive Prestige update is here!

Big Joe can choose 3 intensive skills to enhance his specialization.

notes.title: [Dev's Playbook] 4th Dev's Letter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/516465a6c1b5bd34bdb741c5cba3a5e7bbd203b5.png[/img]

We would like to show our gratitude to our dear 3on3 FreeStyle ballers.

We are sharing our 4th letter from the developer to share an upcoming updates and future milestones for 3on3 FreeStyle.

[b][h2]Future Update Plan For Better Game Experience[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5d5ae2ad69219146be2ed8c106f9872312a2e657.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Fair Play System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Manner makes a good player. Reward for good player and penalty for bad manner! We are preparing Fair Play System to enhance your sportsmanship! Based on your manner score, 4 different fair play level is applied. Your manner score will go up when you actively participate in the game and go down if you intentionally quit the game or AFK. If you keep a high fair play level, you will get extra rewards for your play. If you are in a low fair play level, you will get the penalty. We hope all ballers will show a high level of sportsmanship.
[/list]

[h3][b]2. New MVP Calculation System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We will fix the MVP calculation system and show how your MVP point is calculated on the game result page.

[*] Recently, MVP calculation is based on your volume status. Now MPV calculation will be based on your efficiency and include your fitch success rate. If you miss a lot of shots regardless of your score count, you will not get much MVP calculation.

[*] Extra points will be added for your win and loss. Lost team will have a chance to get MVP player if you play efficiently. During the match, a potential MVP player indicator will be added. Top 1 and 2 players who are having the most MVP points will be marked. 
[/list]

[h3][b]3. Shot Feedback Indicator[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Shot feedback indicator will be added to check your shot quality. Shot feedback indicator will show your shooting touch timing, shot defense status based on the distance from the defender, whether your shot is open, etc.
[/list]

[b][h2]Future Update Plan To Fix Inconvenient Experience[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/edf3111e548d5b7591be7803a7e3ea420fa93154.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Daily Login Bonus Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We know that many ballers were disappointed when missed the final reward because of insufficient login. We will improve the Daily Login Bonus to let you get more rewards easily. New Daily Login Bonus does not have a monthly period. You can get the Intensive Manual as soon as you meet certain login counts. 
[/list]

[h3][b]2. Receive All Function For Mailbox[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We know you are tired of clicking mails one by one and we do understand your frustration. We are currently preparing the 'Recieve All' button for the mailbox! You can receive all mail except packages, items that you need to open when received, and selectable items.
[/list]

[h3][b]3. Item Inventory[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We know that it is hard to check your owned item counts. Item inventory will be added and you can check your XP Drink, Manuals, and Tickets!
[/list]

[h3][b]4. Minor Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor improvement is on the plan. Improvement includes receiving Food Ingredient Box at once, completing Job, leveling your character's skill, pet dismiss functionality, and so on.
[/list]
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We would like to close our letter. We hope all our dear ballers have an enjoyable game experience. Thank you for loving 3on3 FreeStyle.

- 3on3 FreeStyle

notes.title: System Update: Crew System Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e151a339aca20b5238170bb76b97076cb8bd14fa.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City 

The followings are the updates for the end of this month. 

[b][System] 
[/b]
[h3][b]1. Crew System Improvement [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8b495bf39b9a001262ac9023e9281370bad3a2c3.png[/img]

The most exciting news of 2023! Crew system improvement is here! 

Now communicate with crew members from all over the world and get a worthy reward for your crew activity! 

Let’s check out what is the change! 

[b]1. Crew Attendance 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/15e4dbc22bd4a4fa050e5c9fa19b602fd34c880e.png[/img][/b]

- Now you can do your daily attendance check on the Crew page. 

- If you forget to click the attendance button, your attendance will not be checked. Be careful! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b671da272b323a795ac0d3dd0b7a5f5628dd374d.png[/img]

- If your attendance is not completed, there will be an alert right next to the [CREW] menu in the main lobby. 

- Crew attendance will reset at 00:00 PST every day. 

[b]2. Crew Quest 
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/16bfc9f472be753a60722c83e0952369f7ffe12d.png[/img]

- Crew quest is now changed to simple 4 daily quests. 

- Crew quest will reset every 00:00 PST. 

- Based on the cumulative completed crew quests, your final Cooperation Loot Box rank will be determined. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3fe43e8f2e072155939000cd591126c8936e67ca.png[/img]

- One completed crew quest will be converted to 1 point for crew cooperation progress. 

- Once you hit certain points, your cooperation loot box will be upgraded to the next rank and the cooperation progress point will reset to 0. To achieve the next rank, you need to cumulate another cooperation progress point. 

- On every Monday at 00:00 PST, your crew’s final cooperation loot box rank is fixed and will be distributed to all crew members. After distribution, the cooperation loot box will reset to the bronze rank. 

- Please receive your cooperation loot box from the crew quest page before the next distribution day. Your cooperation loot box will be renewed with a new one once you hit the next distribution day. 

- From the cooperation loot box, you can get various rewards at random rates. From the platinum cooperation loot box, you may get Intensive Manual!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4ce9f336fa599d5ee172187897ae36086b5d131b.png[/img]

- If there is an acquirable cooperation loot box, there will be an alert right next to the [CREW] menu in the main lobby. 

- When you receive the cooperation loot box, the crew score will be added based on the cooperation loot box rank. 

[b]3. Crew Ranking 
[/b]
-Now you can see the crew ranking period for each season from the page. 

-Now your monthly crew ranking reward will be determined based on your crew’s cumulative crew scores. 

-You can see your acquirable crew ranking reward via the crew activity page. 

[b]4. Cross Crew System
[/b]
- Users from all platforms can join the crew. 

- To use the crew system, you must be [All Platform match]. 

- If you create a new crew, your crew location will be your current matching server. If you would like to create a crew in a different region, please change your server region. 

- You don’t need to change your matching server if you already join any crew. 

- If your crew fails to fill out the crew migration form, your crew region will be auto-migrated to your crew master’s server region. 

- If there are crews with the same name, an extra code will be added based on the crew creation date. If you would like to change your crew name, please send us a 1:1 inquiry with your desired crew name. Only the crew master can send this inquiry, any other request regarding the crew will not be accepted. 

[b]5. Other Improvements
[/b]
- Crew members are expanded to 75 members 

- New crew feature is added to the crew ranking calculation log. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/dc9ca71d6602f91f32443ba326343031cdea7fe3.png[/img]

- [b][Leave The Crew][/b] option only appears on the activity page. 

- Crew Quest page is removed from the EVENT/QUEST menu. 

- 3on3 Freestyle 팀

notes.title: [UPDATE] Patch Note v.1.1.65.0 (November 9th)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a70b475b216d43647a3239889fd0b44c141c3321.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this week.

[Content] 

[h3][b]1. User Tournament System Update [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ace1d9801d3ac1c7263c747742b4cfd674ef109c.png[/img]

A long-waited system is here! Now you can hold your personal tournament and gather best players in FS city! 

Let’s check out how the system works! 

[How To Create Tournament?] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/052b2444eabaab3533ba1b59e09547344b64f7fe.png[/img]

-Select [Create Tournament] button in tournament mode page 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/78845effacebc5e453868d4e65978fbe876c57cc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8d13de422623badc46906c0451f6e1f3b9e745af.png[/img]

-Set your tournament setting of your tournament. 

You can set tournament name, round, game rules, password, reward distribution, hosting/participation fee, and stadium type 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a0000008fc8a5da8c80ed913db4150cc904ced51.png[/img]

-If you chose [Distribute Hosting Fee] your hosting fee will be used as tournament reward.  

-If you chose [Distribute Participation Fee], participants’ total entry fees will be used as tournament reward. Your hosting fee will be same as other user’s participation fee 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1531f7c7f9fee3523bac33c86d6458787faac4bd.png[/img]

-Reward will be auto-calculated based on your game round and reward distribution setting. To check the reward of each tier, navigate [Reward Information] page 

-Your tournament will automatically starts after 30 minutes of creation 

-You cannot create more than 1 tournament at once. To open another tournament, your previous tournament must be closed 

[b][Promote Your Tournament] [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7cbc3964d761b7c664441a1971e7a69d0a408c3a.png[/img]

-After creating the tournament, you can promote your tournament to all users 

-Press [Promote] button to promote your tournament. You will need 10 points to promote your tourney. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3cfe40fef0a818565ff6b8dacf21db3c011d75ec.png[/img]

-After promotion, you need to wait 60 seconds to be able to re-promote 

[b][Manage Your Tournament] [/b]
-User tournament has 30 minutes of entry recruitment time 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3caae0e3c9b4d80c454f82abb560cff6427903f0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5fdda45fe7389a144c4faa8502a92709b5798125.png[/img]

-If sufficient participants are enrolled, you can immediately start the tournament by pressing [Start Tournament] button without waiting remaining times 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2b961d6762cca50166bc858783dce0f627da58e7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c4ad70db34b8bc576fe3adcb3dccfe5da22defb1.png[/img]

-If you want to cancel the tournament, you can cancel it by pressing [Tournament Cancellation] button 

-If you cancel your tournament, 10% of your hosting fee will be deducted as a fee and remaining 90% of your hosting fee is refunded 

-If your tournament is failed to start due to insufficient participant, your hosting fee will be refunded to your mail box 

-Private tournament requires participants to enter password. Users can see tournament name but cannot enter without password 

[b][Tournament System Improvement] [/b]

[b]1) Line-up party 
[/b]
-If you are disconnected during the tournament, you can always come back to your lineup by accepting the invitation 

-Leader can send an invite to the disconnected user by selecting the empty line-up slot 

-Your squad will not break unless line-up leader is disconnected 

-All 3 members must be online before your round start to proceed your match. If you failed to meet 3 members, your squad will automatically lose 

-Disconnected member will be marked as offline, so you can easily distinguish them 

[b]2) UI improvement [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/27cc5853a4a3099c8e2d0600531ca739bf673cb6.png[/img]

-If there is insufficient entry team, participation member is marked as red color 

-If sufficient entry teams fulfilled the participations, participation member is marked as black color 

[b]3. 1vs1 Coin Reward Change[/b]

We all hear about your postiive voices regarding 1vs1 mode improvement!

Previously, we have reduced the reward earned from 1vs1 mode to prevent abusive behavior.

We have adjusted the reward for 1vs1 mode to make 1vs1 mode more enjoyable.

Please check the changes made:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0f4b6eb01eddca251f55fcdaa5fd49c91730ce01.png[/img]

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: 1vs1 Mode Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f6c2246e4211de56539285e3969db97dd27597fa.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[[b]System[/b]]

[b]1. 1vs1 Mode Improvement[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/472a5eb54cffaa1acd658e5c05e2af658035f289.png[/img]

Enjoy a completely new 1vs1 mode! Control your full squad as you wish!

Now you can control all characters in your team for 1vs1 mode!

Check out the improvement now!

[Control Mode]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/da1d0a90274695f08a5e376227018a36f29222dd.png[/img]

-You can choose your desired control mode

-You cannot change control mode during the game. Only available on the line-up page

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6b5e1f989b8a832470fde7fc1192b2e2bdaacd98.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3b018ce0ea6a531059b4c8cf26a0317087175a8d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/35d9186bbe4a05c9ff1f840cf15d593e434bec98.png[/img]

-You can always check the mode description on the right side banner or bottom button

1) Single Control Mode

-2 AI players will assist your main character

-You can only control the top character in your squad

-You can only choose already owned or rental characters as your AI character

2) Full Control Mode

-You can control ALL characters in your squad

-Changing the on-control character key varies depending on your attack/defense situation

-While you are controlling one character, the remaining 2 characters will change to AI and assist you

-You can only choose already owned or rental characters as your squad member

-Your current ability card, Freestyle, pet, and p-buff settings individually apply to your character

-Pet buff activation requirements work under the following circumstance

*[My Team] Condition: Applies to your “on-control” character. Can be satisfied by any of your characters’ action

*[Enemy Team] Condition: Applies to your “all characters”. Can be satisfied by opponent’s action
-Food buff will be applied to all characters in Full Control Mode 

[Enjoy Full Control Mode]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3a0755aaa4a4515cf942a08e7143d1e57da1efd3.png[/img]

-During Full Control Mode, the camera angle is fixed in a specific setting (You cannot change the camera angle)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0eca649d72733583e6d5d7e06901b23959230aad.png[/img]

-During offense, you can control the character who owns the ball. If you pass the ball, your control is auto-changed to the on-ball character

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cfe0e2fc5c53d69a33872c736a5c02e64932d46f.png[/img]

notes.title: Content Update: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a35dd5f45de44cf566c7214db3388327517d4f33.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[b][System][/b]

[b]Balance Patch[/b]
 
In this balance patch, we have adjusted the shot success rate after performing a shot fake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/22b5f7d64a4a354f65a9a69b245a890f727f90c7.png[/img]

We have found that shot success rate after shot fake was still high enough even after you successfully faked the defender. With this balance patch, now you have to think strategically after your shot fake; will you try shot with lowered success rate, move to safe position to shot, or ask your teammate’s help with return pass?

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: Content Update: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/23b11cad395dc3fe8fc5180d82370a084cd27783.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[b][System][/b]

[b]Balance Patch[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b5bad74efe9a84de2c5650036079f2b590d2700c.png[/img]
 
In this balance patch, the balance of overused characters is adjusted. We are expecting users can see more diverse characters in the match with this update. We have adjusted the balance of unused characters while maintaining their core concepts.

[b]1) Carolina[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0bb9b40ed23025676e0800317229cbc8b223c7a0.png[/img]

To make Carolina’s inside attack stronger, we have adjusted the status bonus to allow her to use Euro Step at a further distance.

[b]2) Pedro[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b219f9cf1850d274f8a03f35aeaaab75a49b15f1.png[/img]
 
Pedro is long loved for his strong steal skills. However, his block ability was also too high in contrast to his steal-focused concept. We have adjusted his block ability status.

We acknowledged that Shadow Steal was too difficult to avoid. We have adjusted the skill effect range. From now on, Pedro needs to check the ball's location to aim for the steal chance. Other players can defend ball possession by distancing the ball from Pedro.

[b]3) Murdock[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/47c3c4f067022304e5949af0fc0e15d8e79036a2.png[/img]
 
Murdock is the top defensive character in 3on3 FreeStyle and possesses various defensive skills. We have kept his strong block ability but gave him a weakness of rebound so other power forward can be used for different tactics.

[b]4) Deacon[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/844e571d3187a216159af6d808d2c96a74b88e0d.png[/img]
 
Including Deacon, defensive characters were overpowered for attack abilities. We concluded that defensive characters should focus on the defense role not attack in order to increase offensive character usage. Frames are added to the basic Shot Motion of Pedro, Murdock, and Deacon.

[b]5) Jack[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8c48ce8f2060703cc84344b4f096cfebe1cfe4f5.png[/img]
 
Jack’s Finger Tip Block is designed to have a short delay which allows him to have a second block chance. However, skill performance was beyond our expectations and hinders the usage of shooting-focused characters. To fix this problem, we added frames to the before and after of the Finger Tip Block animation.

[b]6) Fred[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8c8863cd2f258966b0088a032a269fb49b29396c.png[/img]
 
After a deep investigation of Fred’s Hop Pass, we figured out Hop Pass’s key input timing was too short to activate. We have adjusted the input timing so users can activate the skill easier.

[b]7) Noah[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7b1d107333fdc8fff68486559e6fe90875798d28.png[/img]
 
After the update of Ox Queen, a new p-buff ‘Dribble Motion Speed’ has been added. Noah’s Between The Leg Crossover did not get this buff before. We have fixed his status influence so Noah can dribble faster.

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

tags.balance_change: To make Carolina’s inside attack stronger, we have adjusted the status bonus to allow her to use Euro Step at a further distance.
We have adjusted his block ability status.
We have adjusted the skill effect range.
We have kept his strong block ability but gave him a weakness of rebound so other power forward can be used for different tactics.
Frames are added to the basic Shot Motion of Pedro, Murdock, and Deacon.
To fix this problem, we added frames to the before and after of the Finger Tip Block animation.
We have adjusted the input timing so users can activate the skill easier.

Howl cannot be pushed in the Box Out region.

Howl will keep his position under the post as solid center. Can you push him away?

[b][Shadow Block][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b171ebf664244f519e00e62b5a679de4d72d9978.png[/img]

Howl can block from behind the opponent who is performing a Layup or a Dunk.

Don’t let your guard even if you breakthrough Howl! He can catch your behind like night owl aiming his prey!

[b][Keeping And Pass][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ea1fa144bd1b38ea5f0a966c210a490a66192eb6.png[/img]

After rebound, Howl can connect with a pass while guarding the ball.

Howl can give a pass during keeping motion. If opponents challenge Howl with rebound, use Keeping and Pass to push them away and throw a pass to the teammate in outline!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1fd72c43b57176e358667239f77aae82e381adc0.png[/img]

[b][Overwhelming Presence][/b]

When the opponent is blocked by Howl, blocked opponent’s stamina penalty time will come faster than usual. (Max 2 times per character)

Howl requires you to change your character faster and may destroy your perfect plan! If you do not change, you have to play with disadvantage over others who have not gotten such a penalty yet.

*What is stamina penalty?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/141b0b3e5be2df4bfbd9431125d16d29ea8ac180.png[/img]

If you play a character for a long time, the character will get stamina and stat penalty. Howl has the ability to shorten the penalty time (max 2 times) and call your penalty time faster. Give the opponent a lesson about how fearful Howl is! 

[b][Intensive Skill][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/feb1f65437f435d7ed49c2d3665accf59d769fb7.png[/img]

Howl comes out as Intensive prestige unlocked! Check out his 3 strong intensive skills!

[Touch Pass]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0c359e8359b4cfb18df51b7b9563ac6ffe57791e.png[/img]

[Quick Post Up Turn]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1c09d8fdeb2483b300190d03640cbb929f13ad40.png[/img]

-Deny Intercept]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cad94d9607af897286b6db705dc30e70fdbf9ad0.png[/img]


[b]-3on3 FreeStyle Team[/b]

notes.title: Content Update: Food Truck System Renewal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7c32954dcabb350c87ae90707c85fe12998bc24d.png[/img]

[b][Content]
[/b]
[h3][b]1. Food Truck System Renewal[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0f54953664905ca90b1cf0cf5459c0cc958d5ad7.png[/img]

New Food Truck comes FS city with new recipes and strong food buffs!

Cook your meal whenever and wherever you want!

Let’s check out the grand renewal of food buff system!

[b]1) UI Improvement[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d22e747634a40ba2833ef5914ed5b98d8fee7790.png[/img]

-Now you don’t have to purchase ingredient boxes and recipes anymore. Instead, you can directly purchase your desired ingredients from an ingredient shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a20e5ae06f551e363ec84a6cebd3a7faf2d4feb4.png[/img]

-Now you can see EXACT buff effect of food instead small, mid, and large description

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c1872991b7f3601819df2a1d18242ab93e2fd9e1.png[/img]

-Now you don’t have to visit ingredient shop when you are missing several ingredients. Get it on your hand right away with just one push!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c2ec4a5be2311435804f03408994aeee25c2a660.png[/img]

-Now you can see whether teammates or opponents have food buff before game starts

[b]2) New Food and Ingredient! [/b]

-Fruit Juice (S,M, and L size), Delicious Hamburger Combo, and Fine Gourmet are removed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e430b604bf13c5ec307d9a1dd4cbbe5c552b8dd0.png[/img]

-New 5 foods and 10 point ingredients are added to food truck!
*Basic Food : Fruit Frappe and Fruit Tart
*Special Food : Fruit Punch, Chewy Orange Gnocchi, and Crispy Pineapple Beef Taco
*Point Ingredient : Red Wine, Worchester Sauce, Mustard Sauce, Lemon Sauce, Parmesan Cheese Powder, Bay Leaf, Salsa Sauce, Soda, Parsley Powder, Taco Shell
-When you make a special food, point ingredient is required instead of recipe 
-If you have removed recipes and foods, you will be refunded as new ingredients and foods. Refunded item can be found in your inventory.

[b]3) Get Your Food Buff Anywhere and Whenever! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ac8b3122d8da77f6cc1a42978639dff648d7b81d.png[/img]

-Now you can cook recipe in the line up page!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f6fb3d499a363e877f4d789455be2fdb421215e9.png[/img]

-Utilize filter to check your owned and used foods!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/60e5f713b6808ce7082b3337fb73b0c72adc19b3.png[/img]

- You can cook recipe in FS village also! Food Truck is added in FS village

- To cook recipe in FS village, you should not be in any line up party

[b]4) Change Of Food Buff [/b]
-Pork Ribs
*Short Distance Dunk Success Rate : +3.2%
*Long Distance Dunk Success Rate : +1.6% > +3.2 %
*Rebound : +8% > +6%
-Friend Chicken
*Short Distance Dunk Success Rate : +1.6%
*Long Distance Dunk Success Rate : +1.6% 
*Rebound : +8% > +10%

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: Ability Card System Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3d9aab92365bc77146e54107ec6bc8e28e1cc18a.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City 

The followings are the updates for the end of this month. 

[h3][b]1. Ability Card System Improvement [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/afb2fb7774d7d6d9856d31287cbecd8e22dfe3a8.png[/img]

The grand renewal of the ability card system to let you acquire your wanted card more easily! 

Let’s check out how we improved this core system! 

[b][Card Refinement] [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/676ae0aee696384c0e676a5f3bc66faa8c780f5f.png[/img]

- You can only refine the Platinum grade ability card 

- You cannot refine dual ability card (pizza slot). Dual card can be used as refine material 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/63442560ea7f814eb9c0f5d2ff373f4de7a5866f.png[/img]

- You need 5 platinum cards to refine your selected card 

- Card refinery allows you to change the stat value. For example, if your card stat value is 3 and the possible card value is 1-5, [1,2,4,5] can become out as refined result  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4ec656b5481a1dbe79f575b9150a9e16cca98d64.png[/img]

- If you don’t like the refine result you can recover the refined card. When you recover the card your consumed refine material will not be refunded! 

- Refine and recover will cost certain amount of points 

[b][UI Improvement] [/b]
[b]1) Top User’s Pick [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e1f65717f66932d213c12b6eec2b95f54b055826.png[/img]

- Now you can see the recommended card setting which selected by most users 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a331a39702786f692ae3df4caf53c863a9e9d496.png[/img]

- You can check user’s pick in the EQUIP page 

- User’s pick shows you the recommended ability option for each slot. 

- New character’s recommended card sets may take time to be reflected 

[b]2) About Card Slot [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c7d6570e26f1192f312ace108a0bd4cf0aa2e949.png[/img]

- Check out all the detailed information regarding ability card system! 

- You will be moved to separate web page to see the combination rate and card range of each character 

[b]3) Combination  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ad1093278c34cf6b26d6358b0c1cd7ee20673d5d.png[/img]

- Combination tab is moved to right next to the Purchase tab 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c21f6e22ab98eff99f0ce18d2b0e48209dfacb55.png[/img]

- Now you can directly see the combination rate for each grade (Combination result range has not been changed) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/65b2933660f47d9a65f93b6587212383b64f38a0.png[/img]

- Now you can filter cards based on the sot type 

- You can check combination system whenever you want 

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: Intensive Character Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/48bcf2a1d634d46a5f80b3def62e36eff3118e81.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City 

The followings are the updates for the end of this month. 

[previewyoutube=3WVLR-fv_q8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][System] [/b]

[b][h3]1. Intensive Character Update [/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/69d020970bace1246b2b6fd659778f052a8d12b1.png[/img]

Reveal character’s true strength! Intensive Character update! 

Unlock intensive prestige and unlock intensive skill, costume, and attributes! 

Feel the difference right now! 

[b]1) How To Upgrade Intensive Character [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a1c2264f38c2234d7317d5c967fa1576f67618a8.png[/img]

-You need to have upgradable P5 Lv. Max character to upgrade as Intensive Character 

*For this update, Fox and Ayla’s Intensive prestige is unlocked 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c0c5a22667c804505fb287a1f523ab9e907baa7b.png[/img]

-You need position manual, advanced manual, intensive manual, and position intensive manual to upgrade intensive prestige 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/85498c600c5d74d68513ecdb157f67bc786cfff2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/68d9f9713a9826eb5e5343f89a4549c8c1913aba.jpg[/img]

-You can acquire position intensive manual by exchanging intensive manual or purchase in special lounge 

-Position intensive manual in special lounge is sold as server limited item. Stock will reset on every 1st day of month

-Intensive prestige exists up to P5 and you need associate manuals to upgrade your character 

*For this update, only intensive P1 level is unlocked 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/63b9cdced11dff43bf53ad38c2764dca2ce440c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/43bd3200baa775cb74c389bcbcc1ca98b43341f7.png[/img]

-Once you upgrade to intensive character, you will unlock Intensive skill, Intensive costume, and Intensive status. 

[b]2) Unlock Intensive Skill! 
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/30614a3b3b8290f5898569b901335dc20daf8715.png[/img]

-Intensive character will unlock intensive skills 

-For IP1, you can select one out of 3 intensive skills to use 

-Intensive skill has stronger skill effect than normal skill 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/86d983152258b1c9b04295e602771d27b31f7eb6.png[/img]

-You need intensive training item to level up intensive skill 

-You can purchase intensive training item in shop or in special lounge with 10% discounted price 

-More stronger intensive skills will be updated once we unlock more intensive prestige! 

[b]3) Break Status Limit!  
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/754d74beca631de33406c97bf730bf40535971aa.png[/img]

-You can raise Intensive Character’s base attribute with stat point 

-You will get 30 points once you upgrade to Intensive Character 

-For each level upgrade, you will get 10 extra points.

-By total, you will get 120 stat points

-Based on your character’s base attribute, different amount of stat points will be consumed to raise 1 attribute status 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0476bc89693fe97fcd1ecfd0e3476370d65d0470.png[/img]

-Each base attribute has a max 10 stat upgrade limitation 

-You can freely distribute stat points until you confirm the distribution 

-After you decide on your attribute distribution, you can always reset the stat distribution 

More and more characters will get Intensive updates and specialized strengths! 

Stay tuned for our next update! 

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: Content Update: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b2ce61477ae701d07253edc2518b138a2ff02aba.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City 

The followings are the updates for the end of this month. 

[b][System] 
[/b]
[h3][b]1. Ranked Mode Change 
[/b][/h3]
1) During our previous Ranked season, we received several report regarding abusive behavior to earn Ranked Score unfairly. To avoid such abusive behavior we have adjusted ranked score earned via platform match. 

-Ranked Score earned via Platform Match is fixed as 1 point 

-Ranked Score earned via All Platform Match does not change 

We promise that we try our best to make fair competition environment.  

2) Ranked Mode now becomes tougher to achieve SSS rank! Be the wildest and toughest player for 2022 spring season and grab the golden trophy! 

-Minimum score requirement for SSS rank is lowered to 1601 

-Minimum score requirement for other rank remains same 

[b][Balance] 
[/b]
We have adjusted the Normal Moving Speed status and fixed Deacon’s dunk block motion which is hard to be blocked on certain position. 

We promise to listen to your dear voices and try our best to keep fair and enjoyable game environment. 

[b]1) Normal Moving Speed
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3c66ea17fd5a35caa6febc9ac6a9e4a7e1300676.png[/img]

We have found that normal moving speed’s effectiveness was too effective contrast to our intention. We reduced the normal moving speed buff when you possess the ball to allow balance out the attack/defense situation. 

[b]2) Deacon 
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/88a23c1e122ca653e7c2fcb8f1eb4e6849b719c9.png[/img]

After explicit investigation of Deacon’s dunk skill, we figured out that his dunk motion is hard to block on certain position. To make his dunk skill works as our intension, we have changed Deacon’s block animation. 

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: Tournament Mode Update (Beta. Ver)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ea9374faf2e9538a721af6e34333e640d48e22fa.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[previewyoutube=EJ5Jn8JEiP0;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3ff05eb5c587a1e7b556143cb8263434c5b6590a.png[/img]

We know you all await for the tournament system!

Participate in JOYCITY CUP and be the best team in the FS City!

Let’s check how to enroll your entry!

*Current Tournament Mode is in beta version. More functions will be added in future

[b]1) How To Enter Tournament Mode
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cfb2c12750a9c85553a89049ecd43205dd9a4ed4.jpg[/img]

-You can enter the [Tournament Mode] under Play section
-You must be at least User Level 20 to participate the Tournament match
-You can enter Tournament Mode and spectate tournament without user level limitation
-Regular tournament will be held 3 times on every weekend (Fri, Sat, and Sun). Host hour will be varied based on the server region

*Regular Tournament Open Hour

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d7fa9fe0605476285e0c746023c3409a040a0b3e.png[/img]

[b]2) Tournament Grade
[/b]-3 different Tournament Grade entries available: Amateur, Semi-Pro, and Pro
-You need to collect Tournament Score by participating tournament match to enter higher grade
-You will get more rewards if you are in higher tournament grade

[b]3) How To Participate Tournament

[b][Create Your Entry]
[/b]
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/07dacff4afbb712f8a9e4ebf612a8676d59829d8.jpg[/img]

-Select your interested Tournament and enroll your entry

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/bf8dda5ccc2fe358e310644b6dfc0b55de9fb177.png[/img]

-Press [CREATE AN ENTRY] to create your line-up

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/45c1c97f7f731cc0da6ec732788373e68195311a.jpg[/img]

-You can see tournament information in your lineup

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/22e68ddb3d1f8192a9173722930d66e16c6944de.png[/img]

-You can invite your friend or accept participation request from other users to form your team

-To allow participation request, press [RECRUITMENT] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b7b9335fd78e0b26afa09962eff725563cd83937.jpg[/img]

-Input your recruitment message to advertise your team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/320b9e05b490cd4a193fdb7a8eaa545a9c7af590.png[/img]

-Once you receive the participation request, you can see how many interests you received in the right UI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ae40f4cc84b7431be3b73fab4a1df69898396f21.jpg[/img]

-To accept participation request, press [INVITE] and select player you would like to accept

[b][How To Join Other Player’s Entry]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a8987b9dd42c6e70c431200c8177244673a11860.png[/img]

-Select entry team you would like to join

-You can only join entry without the lock icon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/bee439ed7a08443cbd2ba212d7c31970e5d7a0c9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d49db25eb07a6916c4509d3b3cf00aa7446084fc.png[/img]

-Press [APPLY] to send your participation request

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ef0bcc6f99872ce8a69c090a272e21321d7c882d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a8987b9dd42c6e70c431200c8177244673a11860.png[/img]

-If line-up leader accepts your request, you will see the invitation notice
-Accept the invitation to join the line-up

[b][Finish Your Enrollment]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6d7e5b6b9b6828809a3e18d1ceab25555a23f6b4.jpg[/img]

-After forming 3-member-squad, you can finish your enrollment by paying the participation fee. When you enroll, all members must be online
-You may need certain amount of Tournament Score to enroll your entry
-Participation fee may be points or coin. For beta version, 1,000 coins will be paid for the participation fee

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/bb4f5db08fc5d2b84c2e036ec8763148c7de372b.jpg[/img]

-Once everyone finished enrollment, your entry is completed!
-You can freely navigate other menu while you wait for Tournament starts

[b][Important Notes]
[/b]
-You can enroll your entry once per day. Your enroll limit will reset on 00:00 PDT everyday
-Your entry limit will be counted once your enrolled tournament starts. If you cancel your entry before the tournament start hour, your enroll limit will not be consumed
-You can enroll your entry 1 min of the tournament starts
-You cannot cancel your entry before 5 min of the tournament starts
-Your entry fee will be refunded if you cancel your enrollment or tournament is not opened
-Tournament will start after 30 min of tournament opens! Be ready before the match starts!

[b]4) How To Play Tournament
[/b][b][Basic Rule][/b]
-Tournament match will start after 30 min of tournament opens
-When minimum entry teams are not checked-in, tournament will be canceled. Minimum entry is varied by tournament type
-During beta version, at least 6 teams are required to start tournament

[b][Match Process]
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/29b4fb39304ca91fe55f88fe45109914744b6177.jpg[/img]

-You can see your list of matches once tournament starts. Your opponent team will be randomly selected from entries
-After each round, you will have 1 min of break time
-If you lose for your round, you can still spectate the remaining match

[b][Important Notes]
[/b]-If your line-up leader disconnects, remaining member will be auto-exited for next round
-If tournament match proceeds with party without leader or having problematic match in Final round, tournament will be auto-ended after 15 min
-Any ongoing tournament will be cancelled during the maintenance hour

[b][Be The Winner]
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/70ea5422dded99c48bd82aae2744ebebb32a8e30.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9aa159e23a10c245ef4334ed738fa8a7a8e19372.jpg[/img]

-When all matches are over, you will see the winner and rewards. Your reward will be delivered to your message box

[b]5) How To Spectate Tournament
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8337909a217bb49d151a26dc95ab5b2e88f16cfc.png[/img]

-You can select your desired tournament match to spectate
-You can only spectate after tournament starts and ongoing match. Check the [EYE] icon to find any matches you can spectate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5c3914eb26699ce5d68f183bb240c270b5ca796f.png[/img]

-If you are participants, you will be moved to spectate player once you lose the game
-When you first enter the tournament spectate mode, you will see the current progression of the tournament

[b]6) Check Your Tournament Record
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/39781e25feef7b245eb681ce0539c1666271163f.jpg[/img]

-You can check your tournament record in Tournament Mode page
-You can see your participated and hosted tournament record
-You tournament list will show your current 10 records
-Your list will be removed after 2 months
-You can see tournament detail by selecting your tournament list

[b]7) Be The Top Tournament Player
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/97b021e2b36cbc6126b4f818728f48c5f1efcec3.jpg[/img]

-Based on your tournament score, top 100 players will be determined
-You can see winning matches, MVP, tournament score, and rewarded points of top players

During BETA version, you will receive the following rewards based on your tournament result.​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6ee3cf0545e0970687ec0667f7546dbb5ca9eb0f.png[/img]

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: New Character Update: Fox
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d4e1e32bf783ca941fef4b6676e1e874d65391f9.png[/img]

[b][System] 
[/b]
[previewyoutube=RfU4Jw4rQjs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]1. New Character Update; Fox 
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d123910bcd273d93737d7407b1a95dfc0215fa89.png[/img]

The living legend of street basketball finally comes to reveal himself!

Meet Fox (a.k.a White Fox) who established the Fox Court!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/39fc46bea1f2ea8a67aac7a64233be6cdd05dcdd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3e9b35bdc3cfe2c0b082aacd57292cf0666caee7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/db557e5de24f5c6efb98e081769ee8b244ecd519.gif[/img]

Check out how veteran balls on the street and feel his professionalism!

[b][Slip Screen]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0244639533b32dd7b83fe749a5f0616c4934162f.png[/img]

Performs a fake screen and move quickly. 

Did you think he tries to guard your attack? No, he is preparing for the shooting chance! 

Think carefully when you face the Fox Grandpa! Is he guarding teammates or aiming the scoring chance? 

[b][Spin Move] 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fcc4f7cb4027587bd957455484008dbd8afcae2a.png[/img]

Performs a spin while driving to avoid the defender. Can connect to dunk, layup, and fade away shot. 

Don’t be fooled with Fox’s splendid step! Fox can spin and dribble the ball to let your guard down. 

[b][Hard Screen] 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/faf626c07e0816dd9b07727f18ff993e8e8be97e.png[/img]

Push the opponent while performing screen, opponent will fall down by chance when directly collides with Fox’s screen. 

The chance is affected by Fox’s balance stat. 

Fox can stop the opponent and secure teammate’s scoring chance. Believe the grandpa! 

[b][Blue Worker] 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3675de69f2f949cc7d6752e1f28cf56dfca6f237.png[/img]

Fox grandpa will do the hard work for you! 

Teammate’s moving speed increase for a while if Fox’s screen collides with the opponent. 

Grab a quick scoring chance when Fox guards the opponent for you! 

[b][Veteran’s Dignity] 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/878b1eeba6ecb3fe8ed3b04c3d302006b530f3d3.png[/img]

Fox knows his position more than others.  

When there is a Power Forward in the opponent team, Fox’s Balance and Rebound stats are highly increased. 

Don’t you dare to compete with Fox Grandpa as Power Forward! 

- 3on3 Freestyle Steam

notes.title: System Update: Matching System Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/93e5251865c37471e2dde26d6976e2b96dda27ab.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[h3][b]Matching System Improvement
[/b][/h3]

Based on our matching data, we have improved the lower and higher matching group based on the region.

Now users will meet the opponent with similar skills and levels.

Let’s check how the system changed!

[b]1) Matching Level Change
[/b]
-Low tier of NA/EU matching has extended from Lv.10 to Lv.30

-Low tier of Asia matching has extended from Lv.15 to Lv.25

-If you are in Medium tier, you can select your matching tier between Low or Top

*NA/EU : Lv. 10~30
 *Asia : Lv.15~25

-You can check the detailed information regarding the matching range based on the server in the line-up page

[b]2) Top Tier Matching Reward Change
[/b]
-If you are in Top Matching group, you will earn more coin and exp from 3vs3 mode

-If your level is in Low Matching group but you are matched with Top Matching group, you will earn the same amount of reward for winning

-You can see your matching group in the line up

-You can select you matching tier in the line-up if you are eligible

-Only the line-Up leader can select the matching tier

[b]3) UI Improvement
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9cbc74af554803fd667f9900703ec1d2629f6fe7.png[/img]

-You can see your matching group in the line up
-You can select you matching tier in the line-up if you are eligible
-Only the line-Up leader can select the matching tier

[h3][b]Training Quest Improvement
[/b][/h3]
FS Academy training quest has been improved to help new ballers!

Now you can get the EXP reward immediately once you complete the quest without entering the training quest page!

If you already cleared some quests but have not received the reward, you will get all remaining EXP rewards once you enter the training quest page after the update.

Grow faster with FS Academy!

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

A long-waited feature returns for 2022!

Spectate your favorite players and top matches as many as you wish!

Pick your best player and show your support!

[How To Spectate Matches?]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e2e643a95e32093bfdc7938487da7e1d8fba5dd1.png[/img]

1) Go to [ACTIVITY] – [SPECTATE] from the lobby

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d7fad27678834d1114fabcaa4fd282e5c56aca5d.png[/img]

2) Select match category you would like to spectate : Top Rank / Friend / Crew

3) Select match you would like to see

4) Now you are ready to spectate the fabulous moment!

[Tips To Enjoy Spectate Mode]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ef9eee92e7ee74be4a5fe30b8d5b511f9dc1f494.png[/img]

1) Find your best camera angle to capture the exciting moment! You can simply change it by just pressing the button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7aad5fbb77b7e0de319d582d9b84191e2b1d1de0.png[/img]

2) Vote for your favorite player! You will have 2 vote chances (1 for Home team, 1 for Away team) for each game, and you can vote for 2 games per each day. If you vote, you will receive daily free rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/40003a9f0ad01d3f148e8f384e7c164171908416.png[/img]

3) Check top players’ attributes. You can see selected player’s card setting, attributes, and outfits in detail.

[Check Your Popularity]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a547379873c18c42688607645faca1e39c9767c9.jpg[/img]

1) When you receive vote from spectator, you will get the reward notification after the game

2) Your reward will be sent to your message box

3) You can receive 8 votes per der day

*If you don’t want other player see your statistic, you can turn off it in the option

- 3on3 Freestyle Steam

notes.title: System Update: Lobby Play System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f1dcd600a1d86ca08f44a7d36708d19536c93507.png[/img

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[b][System][/b]

[h3][b]1. Lobby Play System
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/900548888ee807f3365170bdd13ac5d69ab265cf.png[/img]

Have you missed your own lobby court? Here is a great news!

Lobby court is now back!!

[How to use lobby play mode?]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f32a9b276faf1cc6030dac3380e6793bbe8c4362.png[/img]

1) In the main lobby, press button to enter the lobby play mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/197ebeb328add69799069004bdb6c4f5ff8115ce.png[/img]

2) Play as many as you want anytime! There is no limit on FreeStyle usage and stamina! Test your skills as you wish!

3) Weren’t you boring while waiting for next match? You can play Lobby play mode while you are finding a match! Prepare for your next match during waiting time. Once the match is completed, you will be moved to the game.

4) If you want to quit playing in lobby play mode, you can always leave and back to main lobby!

[Action Angle Camera]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/031a9f348a8c37276d0295671a7fa7285e416c13.png[/img]

In lobby play mode, new camera angle is added! 

Action Angle Camera allows you to see your character’s appearance at close distance.

Check your character’s signature moves at capture the scene!

This camera angle is only available in lobby play mode!

You can always change camera angle if you prefer other camera option.

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: FS Village Matching System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5908553bb0a155b14b67276ea1dffd817cb7fe12.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

New System Update: FS Village Matching System

Have you already created your own avatar on 3on3 Freestyle’s new content, FS village? We bet you wanted to play Pickup games with avatars next to you. Now we are gladly introducing our new system, FS Village Matching System to everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/708466f2803942c644cad7957fe313f629437338.png[/img]


To use FS Village Matching system, find NPC ‘JOEY’ on FS Village. Unlike the random matching system from Lobby court, you can input lineup’s name. Name your team and show off your identity! You can also set the name of your matching room, which will be shown in the waiting room list so that you can recruit your ideal member. How about this? – ‘Dope rim protector looking for 3p shooter!’

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2f0716bd1c4ca84efa5ede59c068a4e19eab33a3.png[/img]

The number of recruits is displayed above the head of the avatar that is recruiting for the lineup. You can apply directly through interaction with the avatar if you want to join that player's team. Why don't you decorate your avatar to get lots of entries? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/85fdfad4b4b4392a50ebbe40bf71a1b8660074cd.png[/img]

If you find a team that suits you, don't hesitate to apply! Lineup in FS Village will be returned to the match lineup after the game, allowing each team to continue with the next match. We can't wait to see various teams’ birth on FS Village through this update!

- 3on3 Freestyle Steam

tags.feature: New System Update: FS Village Matching System

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/80c9632c22ed7d395caecdab20b374f40f2c68a9.png[/img]

Greetings FS City Ballers,

The following are the events that will be available to the game starting today!

[h3][b]1. Ranked Mode 2022 Winter Season
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4ba2ff37bdb45072eba3c26b75a242fd875790a1.png[/img]

Event Period:
1/5 ~ 1/18 23:59 PST

Challenge your limit and be the best player on the league!

New Top Baller will rule this winter season!

Only opens 12 hours every day for 2 weeks!

Winter Rank Mode Begins!

Challenge your true skill over all platforms! Who will be the top baller during this Winter season, across all platforms?

Reward List:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/244853186d2852fe318283ac5a362830d2627480.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b027b216e748848c7cae315f6182b0bda9d79ee3.png[/img]

Q&A:

Will my rank be reset from Winter Ranked Mode?

- Starting rank for this Winter Ranked Mode will be applied depending on the previous winter rank.

Check out the below image for more details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c7bbbfde7f7417bc15767ea119a1682e4b9b3927.png[/img]

I want to play Ranked Mode in different regions this time. Will my rank be maintained?
- We have changed that Rank Apply(above image) can be applied to any server where you start the first Winter Ranked Mode. HOWEVER,
if you move to a different region that is different from where you played Winter Ranked Mode, your rank will be reset and cannot be restored.

ex) If you played Winter Ranked Mode at Asia and got SS rank ;
You can get your starting rank A, no matter where you start to play Winter Ranked Mode.

Absent Penalty
- If you do not play Ranked match for a long time, you will receive absent penalty.
- Absent penalty will reduce your rank score
- If you do not own enough rank score due to absent penalty, your rank tier will be degraded

Note :

# Starting rank for the Winter season is applied depending on the previous 2021 Winter Rank.
# Rank will be reset to D if you change your region while proceeding with Winter Rank Mode.
# Check out the time for each regions and don’t miss a single match!

Server Time Standard (PST)
NA : 10:00 – 22:00
EU : 03:00 – 15:00
Asia : 21:00 – 09:00

[h3][b]2. Ranked Mode Challenge Event
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/52cc83b1005aaf3bb07ea4960aa5e87a50bf4c7c.png[/img]

Event Period:
1/5 ~ 1/11 23:59 PST

Play Ranked Mode during the event period!

Finish 7 ranked mode matches and get useful rewards!

*Reward will be sent on 1/12 maintenance

[h3][b]3. Platinum Card Sales Week
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6cbd4f308c77dbf35907f0e7e6b6229850f61d50.png[/img]

Event Period:
1/5 ~ 1/11 23:59 PST

Special Platinum Card Sales! Don’t miss this exclusive chance!

*New character Ayla is not included in the deal

[h3][b]5. Winter Zombie Arcade
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1be40d227b7f894f90ca183b0625591fb2215ae9.png[/img]

Event Period:
1/5 ~ 1/25 23:59 PST

The undead arrived in the New Year’s Winter with frozen zombies!

Make sure to survive and get a chance to get full of surprise!

[h3][b]6. Weekly Top Zombie Hunter
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2ab0f16b7150ed12e3f374956d6534e82b20eb76.png[/img]

Event Period:
1/5 ~ 1/25 23:59 PST

Aim the weekly top zombie hunter to get crowned snowman mask and platinum cards!

Who will be the top zombie hunter in FS City?

*Reward will be sent on scheduled maintenance for each week

[h3][b]7. Roaring Tiger Rank Buff Wave
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/610006c62bf730cc08fa406e6d7bea92a63137cb.png[/img]

notes.title: System Update: New Community System; FS Village
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8da49c675686a8af8ecbeb16af021767645dbc42.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[h1][System]
[/h1]
[h3][b]1. New Community System; FS Village <Beta. Ver>
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/124a007665fca9d33f26333cedbe13cf52eb781c.png[/img]

Welcome to the FS Village! Meet 3on3 FS Ballers from all around the world!

You can find new friend from all platform and make a squad with them to play together!

You can experience FS Village Beta! Let’s see how you can enjoy the new system!

[b]1) Make Your Avatar!
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/43d83635c9fa0d910a8a1b17be602aeb767c6cc8.png[/img]

-Create your avatar before entering FS village

-If you don’t like current avatar, you can reset the appearance

-You want more variation? Visit Avatar Shop to navigate diverse customizing and emote items!

-Manage your avatar outfit and gestures from [Manage Avatar]

-Any adopted pet can hang out with you in FS village!

[b]2) Let’s enter FS Village![/b]
-You can enter by selecting [Enter FS Village] from the lobby

-You will enter recommended village channel of your match region

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/947e96957ffd4c46caa6767d3cdf5b2eed4b1479.png[/img]

-You can move to different channel within you match region. If you would like to change the village channel from another region, please change your match server from matching option

-Each channel can hold max 50 user. If selected channel is full, you cannot enter the channel

[b]3) Let’s communicate with friend![/b]
-You can chat, show gesture, or use emote to express your feeling!

-You can chat with other users from all platforms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/229df0ec842dda0088e937135bee7d531d2a908a.png[/img]

-If you approach close to other user, you can see user’s information or send friend request

-You cannot see user in blacklist even though he is in same server

[b]4) What’s more in future?
[/b]-More function will be added in future! Please wait for an official update!

-You can make a squad and play with them together! Join other user’s squad or make one to play with your friend! This function will be updated in close days!

-More avatar costume will be added!

-Mini game will be added! Play with your friend together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/309a8416aaaa1d4967badd261421b17d93ed008d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/be279f74c8c8615800fb35b000db069432d17990.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more information about FS Village for later update!

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: New Character Update; Ayla
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4b003e57d5865af5f39c496a7584a764f35551b0.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for this month.

[h3][System]
[/h3]
[h3][b]1. New Character Update; Ayla
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0b4fef2dca01ca4009616b989bf25cf3eb2f80f8.png[/img]

The smartest and most elite player joins to 3on3 FreeStyle! Ayla, a younger sister of Nadia, comes to guide you how to ball like “elite”. With the appearance of Ayla, the tension between street basketball and elite player will rise..! 

Meet Ayla, aka Commander, and her fascinating pass ability!

[previewyoutube=sM2OwSDHEeA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][Shammgod Crossover]
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3d9fa84f6ca21292a17f0172077aab8791862bff.png[/img]

notes.title: System Update: FreeStyle Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/239c5503417987199607b6487737684bbf4b6e8c.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[h3][b]1. FreeStyle Improvement[/b][/h3]

The promised update is here! The grand Freestyle renewal for diverse and exciting game experience! Here is the change!

1) More FreeStyle!

-3 FreeStyle slots are unlocked. Now you have 9 FreeStyle slots!

- Each slot will be unlocked on Lv. 15, 25, and 35.

2) Think Your Remaining FreeStyle Limit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/64858418dcc7422109b7be9e066233522bc8853f.png[/img]

-Each FreeStyle has the usage limit for each match
-If you use the same FreeStyle for certain times, FreeStyle will not be activated
-You can always check your remaining count during the game
-Regardless of your shot scores, blocked, or fails, count will be deducted if you make a shot with FreeStyle
-If FreeStyle’s usage count is 0, it will be removed from the list during the remaining game

[h3][b]2. Skill Balance Improvement
[/b][/h3]We listen to your dear voice that some skills have low efficiency and barely used. We investigate the problem and adjust the skill mechanism to increase the efficiency. Let’s see how we made the change!

[Diving Catch / Sliding Catch]
1) Base success rate is highly increased
2) Skill activation height is highly increased

[Floater / Running Floater]
1) Base success rate is increased
2) Skill distance will be determined by Long Distance Layup / Dunk distance
3) If you enhance Floater distance status, skill’s activation range will be increased

[Screen]
-Teammate’s screen will have lower influence on you
-Balance status will affect Screen influence range more
-Shot success rate penalty affected by teammate’s screen is lowered

[h3][b]3. Balance Patch
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/622edc5f1c35b676f094bb1e639e06b1edfdea5e.png[/img]

Walker’s base attribute for Long Distance Layup and Jump Shot Block is increased to make him utilize his strength more. His shot fake skill requirement is changed so you can use both FreeStyle and Shot Fake without problem. 

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/275abe32d68580190398360244234af99e8d3c59.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[previewyoutube=kWW7fA4RVGI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][System][/b]

[h3][b]1. In-Game Guide Update
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a3d26330c7d917dff58d698ff77484f01a674f87.png[/img]

First try is always the hardest. But don’t worry! FS Academy updated new in-game guide lets you learn how to ball! Let’s see what you can learn!

1) Any baller who is below level 25 can see this in-game guide
2) If you don’t need this guide, you can always turn off it from the option
3) When you reach level 25, the in-game guide will be removed. But, you can still use this guide in Free Mode or Practice Mode

[h3][b][Rebound Guide]
[/b][/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/35dd08584e98a6325c0ca060f84a516b1c847552.jpg[/img]

- Green ring will appear when you do the rebound
- The ring size is the area where you can try the rebound
- If the ball is too high or low, the ring will be disappeared

[h3][b][Diving Catch Guide]
[/b][/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0b5ec84962448cc85dec565ea027c6f3ae4fa5fc.jpg[/img]

-Blue ring will appear when you can do a diving catch
-Only characters who own diving or sliding catch skills can see this guide
-The ring size is the area where you can try the diving catch
-If someone catches the ball, the ring will be disappeared

[h3][b][Layup/Dunk Guide]
[/b][/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3b20003f8e7f88cffde32ee9e51eceb215e2142c.jpg[/img]

-When you have a ball, a blue ring will appear
-The ring size is the area where you can perform a long-distance layup or dunk

[Mark Range Guide]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a77c0b95ec808c67a9a6b288d963f4dd892fcd65.jpg[/img]
 
-When someone has a ball, you can see the moving green arc
-This arc is showing the mark range. The size will be changed based on the distance from the post
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c8f2249b42b8ed9e753f5f0ac62784c34b0bb71e.jpg[/img]

-If the opponent is in the mark range, the color will be changed to red. This means that your shot success rate may be affected

-Mark guide can be used regardless of account level. If you don’t need this guide, you can always turn off it from the option

- Opponents can see this range too. So if you are in an attack role try to avoid the opponent being in your mark range. If you are in a defensive role, dive into the mark range to stop the shot!
With these 3 new friends, you can learn 3on3 FreeStyle faster!

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: Content Update: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/38a2173adda86c04e159188e1aff82f9aec04862.png[/img]

[h3][b][Balance Patch]
[/b][/h3]With your continuous opinion and our in-game data analysis, we have adjusted Jack and Deacon’s balance. Please check the change below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9389fb41b0c3ebb73b6cafcf96b7c7aa81fe1087.png[/img]
 
We understand that Jack’s shot and block abilities are high and make other characters hard to counter him. We have adjusted Jack’s shot ability and fingertip block to allow him to utilize his other great abilities and lower the reliability of the block.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/994c36d11d3a445d5f046fe2efab4ceb74cc2fdd.png[/img]
 
Deacon can perform a good defense role even though he has high attack abilities. We have adjusted Deacon’s defense attributes and shoulder charge cool down to let him focus on his Power Forward role.
We will continuously listen to your dear voices, and try our best to make 3on3 FreeStyle more interesting and exciting to all.

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: New Character, Noah
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/378f641b8c246419448e60f79f5a836e25c944c4.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for this month.

[previewyoutube=w5vXEuNMMGU;full][/previewyoutube]

[System]

1. New Character Update; Noah

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2910ab98b166085d719d69f22fc8dc5e941d5ed5.png[/img]

After experiencing the unfortunate accident of losing one leg overnight, this basketball prospect put on a robotic prosthesis and stood back on the court.

What caused the bright-faced boy to harbor deep hatred in his heart? What happened to Noah's past, who seemed lonely for some reason? Let's take a look at Noah, a versatile new shooting guard character with brilliant dribbling, accurate shots and unpredictable passes!

[previewyoutube=IQ4Ce7WRdUU;full][Insert Spotlight Video][/previewyoutube]

[b]Between The Leg Crossover
[/b]
After taking a between-the-leg motion for a certain period of time, Noah can quickly break through the opponent with a crossover dribble.

While Noah is using this skill, his ball cannot be stolen.

Feel the charm of Noah, who has excellent dribbling, shooting, and passing ability to perform triple threat attack after the between-the-leg motion!

[b]Nut Meg [/b]

Noah can quickly move behind his opponent by putting the ball between his legs when he tries to block or steal.

Even the most demanding defenders are prone to Noah's psychological warfare.

Use Noah's Nutmeg skill to embarrass your opponent and complete a brilliant play!

[b]Back Dribble
[/b]
During the dribble, Noah can distance himself from the opponent by backing away in the opposite direction of the goal.

If the opponent tricked by the back dribble steps backwards, the opponent will get an ankle break.

Noah is able to back dribble even during between-the-leg motion. Confuse the opposing defenders and outrun them perfectly!

[b]Obsession[/b]

Noah doesn't lose the ball against single steal attempt, even when the opponent gets a perfect steal against Noah.

A stolen ball has a 100% chance to bounce on the floor and become a loose ball in the air, and mid-air competition is possible.

Maintain possession of the ball with Noah's unique trait of not allowing easy steals!

[b]One More Chance
[/b]
Even if Noah collides head-on with an opponent who is facing up while breaking through the dribble, he can step back for a while and resume his attack.

However, please note that it does not activate during back dribbling.

Enjoy Noah's powerful ball handling ability, which continues to attack even after colliding with the opponent with a certain probability.

2. Training Quest Improvement

Welcome to the FS academy! Here, you can learn your must-know information step by step!

The grand renewal of the training quest is updated! Here is the change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0fc8ee580fcbd333fb6534da603bbf49f0eae277.png[/img]

1) Now you can see the whole list of training quest

2) Now you can progress multiple missions at the same time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d86ae2360f5e5810b4bac6597e4bee26d1c89525.png[/img]

3) You can move directly to the content to carry out the mission on the mission page.

4) There will be 3 levels of the mission: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. Once you complete all missions of one level, you can proceed to the next level.

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: Zombie Arcade Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5cdc71b0e520b7f6b3a00375904c4d1bd95edc55.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for this month.

[Content]

1. Zombie Arcade Mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d92382fbdc277083c87c482dae7cf255c2972a57.png[/img]

Creepy Halloween zombies comes to conquer FS town for this year again! 

Grab your ball and ring the rim to haunt all zombies!

[b][How To Haunt Zombie][/b]

1) Escape from the zombie crowd! If you hit by zombie you will lose your heart!
2) Change the ball color and score it to burn off the zombie with same color!
3) If you haunt zombies, you will get combos. If you haunt more zombie at a time, you get more combs
4) Combo makes your score higher. The more score you have, the more reward you get!
5) If you lose your HP or making a combo, ‘Breaking a curse’ skill gauge will rise.
6) Once the gauge is full, you can knock out all zombies at once!
7) For boss phase, only skill can damage the boss. So burn off more zombies, collect skill gauge, and break the boss!

[b][Important Note][/b]
1) You can receive the reward 3 times a day
2) Based on your score, box grade and amount will be different
3) Box gives out a random reward. You may get the Intensive manual!

[b][Bug Fix][/b]
We have fixed the following issue for this update. 
1) [Steam] Preset change when entering Free Mode with Preset change command
2) [PS4/Xbox] Position filter change after setting an AI on Free Mode triggers game freeze
3) [All] Occasionally, Rugby ball object stays after JFL outfit’s free action is rendered

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: Astro Buff Rank Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f7a89fceb5821c878369224c7685bc76a343c89d.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[previewyoutube=-yKA7ixXCVo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][System]
[/h2]

[h3][b]1. Astro Buff Rank Mode [Postponed][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2bb402cb87fbf108a4a49fb901820569d5f4815d.png[/img]

Show your talent throughout the whole universe!

The brand new fresh game in space, Astro Buff Rank Mode is coming!

Enjoy short, light gameplay with Astro Buff for 3 minutes per match! (Otherwise, you might run out of oxygen!)

No more single setting and strategy! The special Astro Buff will boost your stats to encourage diverse play and setting by season!

Do not miss your chance to win new gold & silver UFO pets, points, ability cards, and nametags!

Check out the following details to become a top baller of this new mode and win fancy rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fbad989425cad6cfb1538e041e1b2373104f75b9.png[/img]

1) Astro Buff Mode is a new rank mode with seasonal buff to certain stats
2) To maximize the advantage of Astro Buff, set your ability cards, freestyles, P-Buff and food buff to boost the stats even more!
3) The stats related to Astro Buff will affect the MVP scoring system during the season. (ex: If Astro Buff boosts Rebound stat, the number of Rebounds will be highly valued when choosing MVP) 
4) In Astro Buff Rank Mode, you can compete with ability cards, freestyles, P-Buff, and food buff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/09f6a9d6eeeaee657518e53629e871414c340cc5.png[/img]

1) A team with more Points after 3 minutes (Short game) wins the match
2) 24 seconds shot-clock. 
3) 1 minute overtime
4) Each team has 1 timeout. You can either change or keep play the same character
5) No Stamina recovery during timeout and overtime

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d8a72d54af8e5dea0eebf27280f34b8395375c6e.png[/img]

Surprisingly, our new basketball arena is in outer space! Hope you enjoy the moon background while playing the game.     

For this season, Astro Buff Rank mode runs for 2 weeks. Our first Astro Buff will boost characters’ stats regarding Steal ability! Therefore, the number of Steals will be valued three times higher (x3) when choosing MVP during this season! Be the best Ball-Stealer and dominate the court!   

To show off your performance on the moon, make sure to check out the following also! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c0ef07784c8bc10f4967ad31e338f11afd85fc02.png[/img]

[b]How can I play Astro Buff Rank Mode?
[/b]
Navigate to [Play] menu – [Astro Buff Rank Mode] menu
When first entering the mode, you can choose one region for your rank system.
Choose one region among ASIA / NA/ EU regions. You can change the region later, but your Rank Score will be reset.
How can I check this season’s Astro Buff?
Navigate to [Event] menu and find the Astro Buff Rank Mode event page
Or, navigate to Rank Mode Squad page and find ‘Rules’ banner.
Check this season’s Astro Buff and make sure your characters are ready to utilize the Buffed stats!

[b]What decides Rank and Tier? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c0ae6487c5d4d95f2fdf863fb3baf77cc49e85bb.png[/img]

Astro Buff Rank mode basically follows the existing 3x3 Rank system.
Your wins and loses give Rank score that would add up to your total Rank score.
Reaching a certain score mark would instantly put you on a Tier. Top Tier, on the other hand, is a little more particular.
To reach Rank SSS, you must fulfill both score and top place. Even though you have at least 1900 scores, you must in the Top rank in your region to be Rank SSS.
What should I avoid while playing Astro Buff Rank Mode?
Make sure you don’t leave in the middle of match! Penalty will be applied right after the game.
For those players with penalty cannot join or be invited to the Rank mode for 1 hour.

[b][Astro Buff Rank Mode Rewards][/b]

But don’t worry! Unclaimed items will be directly sent to your Message Box at the very end of the event.

Check out this season’s special reward! You may not miss adorable new UFO pets, name tags, points and ability cards!

notes.title: System Update: AFK Penalty System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ae75cf32eafe82f2c16cb39bdd3f32746a04362c.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. AFK Penalty System
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c41697d0362638d792f75665379fe50bd3d59f6b.png[/img]

Thank you for your patient! As we announced in our previous note, we updated the AFK penalty system!
Let’s see how it works!

1) If you do not participate in the game for a certain time you are regarded as an AFK user.

2) If there is an AFK user, the remaining teammate can vote to kick the AFK user.

3) AFK users will not receive any reward from the match whether the user is expelled from the match or not.

4) AFK users will get penalty points.

5) If AFK user cumulates enough penalty points, he will receive the penalty to play the game.

6) Expelled AFK user will be replaced to A. I. from the game.

We will continuously revise this system and keep our best to provide a fair game experience.

notes.title: System Update: New Character Camila
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/37f793092bd99a303a7f6a0269c7af20a1a6d94a.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City.

The followings are the updates for this month.

[h3][i][b][Camila Trailer]
[/b][/i][/h3][previewyoutube=bInB3bVzIHw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][i][b][Camila Spotlight]
[/b][/i][/h3][previewyoutube=azQsJh3S1pk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b][System] [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]1. New Character, Camila

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/985ee1a41f76c6849f792c58de650ecd940000e5.jpg[/img]

[/b][/h3]
Team physician during the day, party queen during the night, a new legend with dual attractiveness joined to Big Flow team! The healing of goddess, Camila (a.k.a IASO), will support your play with her smart and fast pass skills. Let’s check about her charming points!

[h3][b]Camila’s Unique Skills:[/b]
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8679003d913e838d248c405abf145b31feadd4fe.png[/img]

[h3][b]Toss Shot[/b][/h3]

Quickly performs a close-range shot as soon as she receives a pass while in a ready pose.

Camila can make a quick and effective shot while giving pressure to the opponent.

As soon as she touches the ball, she will ring the post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3a98c23b04dcbbf169cb99430caf1792e96cb057.png[/img]

[h3][b]Dash and Tap Pass
[/b][/h3]
After dashing a maximum of 3 times, passes the ball immediately after a rebound.

Camila can give you an immediate counterattack chance.

Be ready to receive her pass and make a shot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/dd8d8fe3b7db556480b3cd94341453ac77db4a17.png[/img]

[h3][b]Tiki-Taka
[/b][/h3]
Grants ‘All Shot Success Rate’ buff that lasts 10 seconds to teammates who receive Camila’s return pass within 3 seconds.

Camila will enhance your shot success rate if you successfully receive her return pass within 3 seconds!

When you receive this exclusive buff, you will feel like you are blessed by Goddess of Victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8ac9e96fedf3b7fa2a959e7452a561654f4102e6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Free Up Space
[/b][/h3]
Camila’s Rebound stats increases significantly if 2 or more opponents are outside the 3 point line when someone (including Camila) makes a shot.

Don’t let your guard down! Camila will strengthen her rebound ability if you try to make a 3 point shot! 

[h3][b]2. Legendary Outfit Package Renewal
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/21d304004c6b31c24bae999e28491fc2765de1bd.png[/img]

Want your character’s special outfit but can’t pop up the package because you already raise them P5? No worries!

Now you can see the exclusive outfit package for your P5 characters!

Be careful, this package is available for a limited period from the first pop-up.

*Exclusive Legendary Outfit Package is available when you upgrade your character P5 or acquire P5 character.

[h3][b]3. Custom Camera System
[/b][/h3]
One of your most wanted systems is updated! 

Now you can set your camera angle of your preference!

Let’s check how you can change your camera!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/dbeaaf07a04a983a9af06e26b62813ac5028062d.jpg[/img]

1) Go to [Options]-[Menu]-Toggle Camera Setting

2) Move left or right to select your best camera angle

3) You can also directly change the camera angle during the game by clicking the button! Your changed camera angle is auto-saved

*If you play as local co-op camera change key will not be shown

4) Custom camera is applied to1vs1, 3vs3, Ranked, Rank 3x3, Free Mode, Practice with Jefferson modes

4 Camera Angle is available! Check it now!

1) Basic Camera
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ed7a7b3b956df65e8798288861bfaeddb603d031.jpg[/img]

2) Classic Camera
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/87d0d043f64286be9b4e6344eacc3371fd884972.jpg[/img]

3) High Angle Camera
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6c02e65535adea9580b70649e7a27c1ca5d039d9.jpg[/img]
 
4) Sky View Camera
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6e6c874c3e5951aac49d2ec5b4dd31f1c2a2e516.jpg[/img]

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

2. Legendary Outfit Package Renewal
3. Custom Camera System
