notes.title: System Update: New Fixer's Secret Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a851e2bfad22104ab934c67113055f0566691a40.png[/img]

Greetings FS City,

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[b][h2][System]
[/h2][/b]
[h3][b]1. Fixer’s Secret Support [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f4342ecffa9529840066af1e9cc3f0fe07ba188b.png[/img]

Start with your favorite P5 character and pack your special gifts together!

Newcomer exclusive secret support from the fixer event update!

Meet the Secret Support Box to get a P5 special character and exclusive Jack The Pink outfit!

[h3][b][How to get my P5 character?]
[/b][/h3]
1) Go to the event page and enter the Fixer’s Secret Support event page

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/39f0e140dc8f986d3a3bd8f587d58d65a9c37cd8.jpg[/img]

2) Select your P5 character of your preference. You may change your desired P5 character until you pull the P5 character from the box. 5 recent characters(excluding the most recently updated character) will be available to choose from..

3) Open the Support Box with points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9d28f14eaff42256c56c98b8e826f38d571700c2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/12b0455021a5c47d8d96f4e6f45a9f2252679a08.jpg[/img]

4) You will get one of 3-grade-boxes per each draw and get a reward which is acquirable from the box (item list is different based on the box grade)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7f4bb7d96e40993f5fcd9fe256c3e31fcae05dae.jpg[/img]

5) If you get a reward from the platinum box, the drawn item will be removed from the platinum box item list. So, the more you pull the item from the platinum box, you will get a higher chance for the desired item.

6) If you draw all items from the platinum box, you will get x10 selectable platinum card packs whenever you draw a platinum box. 

[h3][b][Get Extra Reward With Mileage]
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5e9617c178c328cfc2e8e9a173ad6865f0f7543c.jpg[/img]

1) You can use mileage acquired from opening the support box to purchase various items in the Mileage Shop.

2) For x1 draw, you will get 1 mileage. For x10 draw, you will get 10+5 mileages.

[h3][b][Special Notes]
[/b][/h3]

1) All new users will get this event for 30 days since their first login. 

2) You have to clear training quest no.1 to open this event

3) You are not a newbie? Don’t worry! All users will get this event for 30 days after 6/2 maintenance

4) Check each grade-box reward list

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8eabb60b605925bac8f46287a86d2b504fb946b8.png[/img]


- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: Mentor/Mentee Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ef366efda2a0b8304ff3560dedb7ae76f2addaf1.png[/img]

Greetings FS City,

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[previewyoutube=fyTw_UXHP2A;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][h2][b][System][/b][/h2][/i]

[h3][b]1. Running Mate; Mentoring Event [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9fe555ddec8129b5d8f0f01b64d3dfb3b099a67b.png[/img]

Is it hard to you to start 3on3 FreeStyle alone? Don’t worry! Find your dear mentor and play game together! Your running mate, mentor & mentee system updates!

[b][How to participate event?][/b]

1. If your level is 10 or below, you will be assigned as “mentee”
2. If your level is 11 or above, you will be assigned as “mentor”
3. Go to event page and get your role! Once you enter the event page, your role will be assigned!
4. Once you are paired with mentee or mentor, you can start the event together
5. Clear various missions and collect Running Points to receive exclusive reward! Mission detail is different between Mentor and Mentee.
6. If you delete your mentor or mentee, you can still receive your remaining rewards. But to receive further reward, you must find another mentor or mentee to resume the vent

[u][b][All about Mentor][/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8dad733848749d269800b35d8b78e393159b13bc.png[/img]

1. You have to be level 11 or above to become a mentor

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/db6a1116c64d5d1bd66181f074f302e6bfd99cd6.png[/img]

2. Post your Mentor Application post via Mentor Application Board to appeal your skills

3. You can type max 30 characters to introduce yourself

4. You can edit your post max 4 times a day. Once you update your post, your post will be at the top of the list

5. Mentor application board can show up to 200 posts and old post will be not be exposed in the application board if it is not updated when the 200 posts exceeds. When the post number becomes below 200, your post may be exposed again.

6. To start the event, you must be selected by mentee. Mentor can have max 3 mentees. You can delete mentee.

7. Once you delete your mentee, you need to upload new post to have another mentee.

8. Your post will be deleted if you have 3 mentees

[u][b][All about Mentee]
[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e7a2188023672318faca4af887b6d684ffab3499.png[/img]

1. You have to be level 10 or below to become a mentee

2. Find your mentor through Mentor Application Board. You can refresh the board to see the most recent posts

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fcd0ee002db5528b6e51f1955ed3168e6a89fa2c.png[/img]

3. Select the post and chose your mentor. Mentee can have one mentor and if you have mentor, you cannot select post

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/927c1e916db91df32fdffe529f409f5882bd7aa2.png[/img]

4. Mentee can delete a mentor. If you delete your mentor, you need 12 hours to be able to select another mentor

5. To start the event, you must select your mentor

[u][b][Important Note][/b][/u]

1. You cannot add your mentor or mentee to blacklist. You must delete the relationship beforehand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8834c35dc461a3b7c3dcb1018bf9fcb005d9c6ae.png[/img]

2. Mentor or mentee is not counted as “friend” but you can still see in your friend list

3. Mentor and mentee have different reward. Please check out what you can get from this event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/79b1bad5cfc42b3c86d2dbff229c21845dfa23de.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/54d88d6633d11f65a6f40b0d00328f0efbc51512.png[/img]


[h3][b]2. Daily Package Improvement [/b][/h3]

Check out the daily deal more easily! 
Look at all daily deals within one glance and find out your most wanted items!

[Daily Package Change]

-Now you can check the daily package detail from the shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d84da79ae257d7f75e66dd89fd3143dcca89c1a4.png[/img]

-Select the [Detail] button to check out the daily package components and price deal at one glance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fe1f4c142afb09ed72d7d187aafebb9efaaffe59.png[/img]

-Selectable FS Platinum pack is added to the daily package

-This item allows you to select a character to open a character exclusive FS platinum pack

*With the update of FS Platinum pack, now all characters can acquire all FreeStyle regardless of one's position

-Selectable item will be sent to your message box upon your purchase

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c86513d2630913087a2b2129bd3ba8ab38933c0d.png[/img]

-Daily package components have changed. Please check out the daily deal!

[h3][b]3. Social Page Improvement [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/25343fc28308f6410761f981015e7cf534974474.png[/img]

Get our most recent news from the game! 

‘New’ mark will be added to the social tab so you can know there is new 3on3 FreeStyle news!

Don’t miss out on the important notice!

[h3][b]4. Deacon’s Post Push Change [/b][/h3]

After reviewing Deacon’s Post Push carefully, we have concluded that Post Push works beyond our design intention and this phenomenon influences the game environment as opposed to our purpose. To cultivate a better game experience, we have adjusted Deacon’s Post Push as follows:

1) Post Push will push only ONE target
2) Post Push will end if there is no target to push
3) Post Push now has a cooldown for 1 second. Cooldown UI is added under the character, so you can check the cooldown.

[i][h2][b][Bug Fix][/b][/h2][/i]

We have fixed following issues, please check the detail:
1) Saru’s Double Clutch Dunk Mirroring angle adjustment
2) Deacon’s Shoulder Charge success range adjustment
3) 1+1 package platform present bug is fixed
4) Game crashed when you position filter issue is fixed
5) Unable to receive some Battle Pass Mission Reward is fixed 
  : Badge compensation is sent. 
  : Event period is extended for another 2 weeks 


[i][h2][b][Contents][/b][/h2][/i]

[h3][b]1. Level Achievement Packs Update[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/51fee83b3efd32f553935fef00dc6014a26e7b93.png[/img]

The higher level you reach, the more cost-effective deals will be available!
Once you reach a certain level, an exclusive deal to achieve the level will be popped just for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/646414c87b53a223f9007070b104987414e782bb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d850f8019a982b1e9c8d8e5611f5a046ca1335b2.png[/img]

[h3][b]2. Legendary Outfit Pack Update[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/bef258aa7d24736e4caee26311f9603017325e2a.png[/img]

No more regret for missing Legendary DLCs!
Unique Legendary Outfits for each legend are here for you!
Get the most valuable outfits designed for only selected heroes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/620c61957de40c5926d68474b736db6152579cf9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/74b8aaa1ae484c4bc0c40287a986e892a6f794e0.png[/img]

Only available to find out once you get P5 character by upgrading the prestige level or successfully pulling the Character from the shopping bag.

notes.title: Battle Pass Issue Fixed
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1b77d81838a235755b23c4d4102a5709fc3bf9aa.png[/img]

Greetings Ballers,

We wish to inform everyone that we have fixed the following Battle Pass Issues:

1) Cannot acquire badges when completing missions
2) Cannot redeem backpack item for completing 12 Bingos

As we fix the issue, we have expanded the battle pass period for 2 weeks so users can catch up on badges that have been lost during issues.

Also, we have sent battle badges to users who faced unable to get a badge by completing the mission issue as compensation for the problem.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: System Update: Rank 3x3 Mode Returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/09d8a55db71c76f4aaf1db69d157ed0437aabaff.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City.

The followings are the updates for this month.

[b][System] [/b]

[b]1. Rank 3x3 Mode Returns![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cbdc801774f9d56b87b6e72bd02274eea242f88e.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=a2is9ZuE-es;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Event Period:[/b] 4/14~5/11 23:59 PDT (4weeks) 

Time to prove your true skills!! 
You can trust the characters’ own abilities and your skills only! 

Rank 3x3 Mode returns, where you can compete with your own skills, not with Freestyle, ability cards, buffs(Food, Position, Pet, etc)! 

In this new 2021 season, there will be [b]a massive “moving speed buff’ on every character only for Rank 3X3 mode.  [/b]
Well, we all look forward to seeing speedy and dynamic matches than ever~ 
This is the very first Rank 3x3 Mode after cross-play applied to 3on3 FreeStyle as you and we all know, so we may identify the final winner between platforms and all over the world! 
Guess who will be awarded a season-exclusive crown and Honorary Tunic in this rank 3x3 season~?    

Grab all the info from below before heading out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/51dd1fa4ad9fff3063e9aba5e6c0a03c38aef676.png[/img]

- 3x3 mode is 8 minutes long Single rounded match.
- A team with 18 Points wins.
- A coin flip shall determine which team gets the first possession.  
- Ball exchanges in the ‘No-charge zone’. The defensive team is not allowed to either possess or steal the ball in this area. The offensive team has 10 secs limit in getting the ball within the area, otherwise, the other team gets the possession.
- 12-second shot-clock 
- Any Successful shot inside the Arc gives 1 Point and 2 Points for a shot outside the Arc.
- Stamina recovers during time out

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fe86a4e416374d5e087ce785ac4cdc5edce1ebf2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c84bf9e259874551d5a61d17471197231e28a8d7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/91ae08d727edbace96555229abe29be619d4f492.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/36ce7d6e1e9eceeb0e842b058966ed61eaebcfd3.png[/img]

- New basketball arena in a beautiful beach park in the background.
- Witness Backboard breaking Dunk only on 3x3 mode along with bonus action from the rest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/16be7ca5f8e07a7cb41e3047047ffd5ac992893d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fe86a4e416374d5e087ce785ac4cdc5edce1ebf2.png[/img]

This season’s 3x3 mode runs for 4 weeks and opens only for 12 hours every day. And without an exception, we brought the Ranked system with it! Bring your best performance to 3x3 and claim the Top Tier Rewards!

[b]Q&A [/b]
[b]Where can I find the current leaderboard?[/b]
: Navigate to the Event menu to check the most up-to-date Rank and your performance.

When does the mode open by region?
NA: Everyday during 11:00 – 23:00 PDT
Asia : Everyday during 22:00 – 10:00 PDT
EU: Everyday during 4:00 – 16:00 PDT  

[b]What decides Rank and Tier?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fec5a7838c9ad28216f6f72de93690c0cd3fce41.png[/img]

Your wins and losses give a Rank score which would add up to your total Rank score. 
Reaching a certain score mark would instantly put you on a Tier. Top Tier, on the other hand, is a little more particular.

To reach Rank SSS, you must fulfill both score and top place. Even though you have at least 1900 scores, you must in the Top rank in your region to be Rank SSS.

[b]What would make me demoted from the current Tier? [/b]
: Any abusive Behavior (AFK, DC)
: 7 days of absents from the mode
: Continuous lose

[b]Medal [/b]
The medal is the new scoring system on 3X3 Mode. Medals are awarded to players in the winning team and decided on individual performance from one single match. Successful Shots, Rebound, Block, Assist and Steal will be counted and decide the color of your Medal. Excel in your team and Gold Medal is yours! Get more Ranked score with Gold Medal and get yourself an edge over your teammates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/48f8b668a428955c0058b25578c326fdfa7005b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e082546e92f4dcbfc4065bca246a977d822af95c.png[/img]

[b]Rewards [/b]
Claim your Rewards by entering the event page when the season is finished. The page is open for another 2 weeks and any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your Message box at the end. You won’t miss a single reward! For Rank 3X3, exclusive 3x3 Honorary Tunic outfits with Spring Crown are awarded to Rank SS and SSS! These are Rewards for your final Tier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/656b1f54ce141954150ca085b127483be0614d5e.png[/img]

[h3][b][ Bug Fix ] [/b][/h3]

- Jack Character able to shot without ball clearing is fixed.
- Deacon Shoulder Charge not engaged to Jimmy while in Postup is fixed. 

[b][i](Before)
There was no effect when Deacon uses Shoulder Charge to Jimmy who is using Power Postup skill. 

(After)
If Deacon uses Shoulder Charge to Jimmy who is using Power Postup skill, Jimmy will not be attacked but Deacon would be pushed out.[/i][/b] 

- Jack unable to block Rebecca’s Pullup Jumper or Turn Around Fadeaway is fixed. 
- Image error of web-cooperation event’s 2nd and 3rd reward is fixed

notes.title: System Update: New Character, Jack
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3abf169611008d67ed45daade69fe7d19f098bc4.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City.

The followings are the updates for this month.

[i][h3][b][Jack Trailer][/b][/h3][/i]
[previewyoutube=7G4fK08razo;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][h3][b][Jack Spotlight][/b][/h3][/i]
[previewyoutube=TzUorh7yN8g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b][System] [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]1. New Character, Jack [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8b64d1d6f36980092717670019ebed00ea5e2c9f.png[/img]

Pleasant and simple, but loyal, guess who? 

Jack, who is well-known as a tattoo artist and working as a troubleshooter under the nickname “The Fixer” in the back alley of FS city. 

There are many different stories about the buzzing “The Fixer”, but Jack is the man who moves as a solver only with his belief, “loyalty”! So, shall we check out the fixer, Jack’s skills on the court? 

[u][b]Jack’s Unique Skills [/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/be67780964d401ef56b2524721f77ffe9216947b.png[/img]
[b]Screen Spin Move [/b]

While dribbling, Jack can do a spin move to the behind of teammate’s screen by deciding the direction he prefers! Well, we all would expect his skillful play through teammate’s screen! 

Who will be Jack’s screen-backup to let him spread Screen Spin Move skill? A strong Jimmy? Big Joe? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cfa9a9d99770baec494ca8c183917cada3783b66.png[/img]
[b]Pump Fake Spin Shot[/b]

Jack can do the fake while pivoting, rotating to the direction he wants, and then jump shot with his back to the defense!  

His right side? Left? Right? 

I bet, no one will know which way Jack would rotate and use Pump Fake Spin Shot when he is pivoting! 

Unless someone might read his mind~! Look forward to seeing the interesting match!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0d05afc0ffa9aaeca84652a907602220b91af4f9.png[/img]
[b]Fingertip Block[/b]

Jump shot~~~ Tip! 

Only with one fingertip! Jack can touch the ball which was from the opponent’s jump shot and let it be available for a Rebound! 

Furthermore, unlike normal blocks, he can follow and block again even after being faked by the opponent’s shot fake. 

You need to consider using this unique Fingertip Block skill at the right timing as it needs a wait time for recharging after use. 

Oh, I already can see the intense matches for a rebound after Jack’s Fingertip Block success~!!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fd5e419aec104e2ab5bacf8b77329c1291dbd398.png[/img]
[b]Change The Flow[/b]

[b]If Jack’s shoot success when behind more than 3 scores during the match, all teammates’ ‘Jump shot block ability’ will increase for a certain time.  [/b]

The Fixer, Jack came to Change The Flow! If Jack makes his goal when behind with more than 3 scores, all teammates’ jump shot block ability will be increased~ 

Go for marking and blocking opponents’ every jump shot! Literally, Change The Flow!!      

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/617cdafe370814fc5daedbfdcd38144a9c245040.png[/img]
[b]Butterfly Effect [/b]

[b]After Jack's successful shot which leads to the reversal, every teammates’ ‘normal move speed’ will be increased highly for a certain period.[/b]

His most attractive trait that everyone would love! 

If Jack, the fixer success in his shot which leads to the reversal, every teammates’ normal move speed will be highly increased! Faster than anyone~~!! 

Yeah, maybe they will get way faster with the excitement of reversal!     

[h2][b][Improvement] [/b][/h2]

[b]1. Matchmaking improvement for Ranked Mode[/b]
There will be an improvement update on Ranked Mode matchmaking, for providing a better game environment and gameplay balance. 

[h2][b][Bug Fixes] [/b][/h2]

[b]1. Preset bug fix of sudden change in cross matching game[/b]

The bug that sudden random change of preset during cross matching game has been checked, and will be fixed during today’s maintenance. 

We apologize for the inconvenience for game play. 

[b]2.	Bug fix for abnormal score changes at Ranked Mode [/b]

The abnormal score changes at Ranked Mode will be fixed during today’s maintenance. 

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

To the official homepage, youtube, facebook and twitter while at the ingame! 

Meet new game friends and check the latest news from 3on3 FreeStyle out!

Spring came to FS City~ 

Enjoy this season at pinky court and at the lobby with blossoms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/576d754affc08ce705964774a8a61cae6394020e.png[/img]

Spring Ranked Mode Begins! 

Challenge your true skill over all platforms! Who will be the top baller during this Spring season, across all platforms? 

Also, enjoy the changed Ranked Mode map of spring cherry blossoms! 

Q&A:

Will my rank be reset from Winter Ranked Mode? 
- Starting rank for this Spring Ranked Mode will be applied depending on the previous winter rank. 
Check out the below image for more details! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/50d3919d88e6500e36cd20db096ef861bbe208c6.png[/img]

I want to play Ranked Mode in different regions this time. Will my rank be maintained? 
- We have changed that Rank Apply(above image) can be applied to any server where you start the first Spring Ranked Mode. HOWEVER, if you move to a different region that is different from where you played Spring Ranked Mode, your rank will be reset and cannot be restored. 

ex) If you played Winter Ranked Mode at Asia and got SS rank ; 
 You can get your starting rank A, no matter where you start to play Spring Ranked Mode. 

Note :

# Starting rank for Spring season is applied depending on previous winter rank.  
# Rank will be reset to D if you change your region while proceeding Spring Rank Mode.
# Check out the time for each regions and don’t miss a single match! 

[b]Server Time Standard (PST)
NA : 10:00 – 22:00
EU : 03:00 – 15:00
Asia : 21:00 – 09:00[/b]

Various colors and curly hairs~ 

Why don’t you visit the hair salon to celebrate Spring? 

Price : 20points

notes.title: System Update: Matching System Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ad094c0906bd619ff6237dfb8e952bb570f92266.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City.

The following are the updates for this month.

[[b]System[/b]]

1. [b]Special Pick[/b]

Aim your wanted item and pick it! 

The Special Pick is now available on Steam! During 2weeks starting from today at Steam! 

Right now, go get your try and test your luck!

2. [b]System Improvement for Novices: Protected Matching[/b]

Dear new comers to 3on3FreeStyle, and still-being-training novice players at 3on3FreeStyle! 

We all understand your hard times to win on actual game play with skillful players. 

Now, we gladly to introduce safer matching to new players or players with low win rate. 

- Search and match users with similar level/competence preferentially
 ** Protected matching would not be applied once player’s account level becomes 11 and above.

Newly-upgraded 3on3FreeStyle for Newbies, experience it now!

[b]Q&A[/b]:

[b]I want to learn fast even though I am a newbie. Can I play with high level players or skillful players?[/b] 
- You can match with high level players regardless of your account level, if you win rate is high enough. 

[b]I’m worrying about longer time for matching due to protected matching [/b]
- Player search field will be expanded in case of failure to find users with similar level, within certain time. 

3. [b]Ranked Mode Reward Distribution[/b]

As Ranked mode issue has been fixed, the fixed Ranking Page will be opened and rewards for Ranked mode will be distributed. 

We sincerely appreciate your patience and waiting for us. 

Check your ranks and rewards after maintenance today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5a2a4c293f79d4bc2a5f32092c78fa2c0f2ffbd1.png[/img]

We finally have Special Pick event at Steam!  
You know what? Slightly changed special pick list is waiting for you~ 
All is yours! Do not miss this chance to try your luck!  

Is it first time you meet Special Pick? This is how it works!  

First, Pick a list. Browse the available list till you find a list that has the item you want.

Second, Wait until item shuffles. Here’s a tricky part, all the item flip backwards.

This is the stage where you take a random pick.

Third, if you are sure about your pick, flip it open by spending 17 Points.
Afterwards, your pick goes straight to Message box as you flip it open. 

[b]Q&A[/b]:

[b]While flipping my items open, I accidentally press back and exit the event. Would I be able to see my list again? [/b]

notes.title: System Update: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/616a8ef830fd72d248d799992b21b2981de87f30.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0e1d914be8a1a26f59c9ec44b0546d0a5398b054.png[/img]

We hope all of you have a bunch of thrilling buzzer-beaters in 2021!

We would like to introduce our first balance patch of 2021.

Based on our dear ballers’ pick rates and play results, we picked 5 characters for our first round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e1023cb73522127f60a4fd5d0974e6de7fc47322.png[/img]

Fei’s high scoring ability is remaining the same. With the improved Chip Out and Steal Counter, will gain a huge synergy power in Big Two position. 

We enhanced Fei’s base attributes to let her mark the fast opponent more effectively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/331b0b4fc5e4a6aa12fdd61f212d8239b574763c.png[/img]

Rin will have more opportunities to make space. We enhanced Leg Through Back Dribble skill to allow Rin to use more Jump Shot to maximize her ability. 

Now One Ultimate Shot and Shot Fake Pass are more usable than before

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d793209714ff37d6360a144406a4a3b59995f72b.png[/img]

Rebecca was powerful only when she has a ball. We want her to take SF role whether she has a ball or not. 

We enhanced Rebecca’s base attributes so she can perform threatening play when she is doing an indirect attach or defense position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0fed05e7194c46e3073104ae5c1b119bb70ea38c.png[/img]

Little Fox had a fast and fierce attack ability even though he already has a strong defense skill. 

We adjusted his shot abilities and enhanced Court Commander skill to allow him to focus on his role as PG.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4188eb49d811c0c2bac042246adac4b82f65e754.png[/img]

Jimmy’s ability was biased to Rebound than other Big Man. We adjusted his rebound attribute while reducing the stamina

cost of his shot skills. Jimmy can perform his powerful shots more than before.

We promise to listen to your sincere voiced and continue balance patch through analyzing big data collected from FS ballers in more depth.

3. Balance Patch In-game Notice Available

We understand that a balance patch is a very sensitive issue to our ballers. To enhance the change visibility, a UI guide is

added to the character after the balance patch so users can know which characters get changes.

1) Where I can find Balance change?

- Go to [MANAGEMENT] and press the square button to pop up the balance patch detail page

-On line up page, characters with balance patch will have [BALANCE] tag

This update will allow you to recognize the balance patch and find the detail easier.

4. A. I Improvement

A.I has improved to give you a more enjoyable play experience. One notable change is that when the score difference is huge, A.I now forfeit the match. Forfeit requirement is the same 1) play at least 1 min for a 2nd round and 

2) score difference is at least 10. 

There are more other improvements in A.I system so don’t hold down your controller when you meet A.I!

- 3on3 FreeStyle Team

tags.balance_change: We enhanced Fei’s base attributes to let her mark the fast opponent more effectively.
We enhanced Leg Through Back Dribble skill to allow Rin to use more Jump Shot to maximize her ability.
Now One Ultimate Shot and Shot Fake Pass are more usable than before
We enhanced Rebecca’s base attributes so she can perform threatening play when she is doing an indirect attach or defense position.
We adjusted his shot abilities and enhanced Court Commander skill to allow him to focus on his role as PG.
We adjusted his rebound attribute while reducing the stamina cost of his shot skills.

tags.feature: To enhance the change visibility, a UI guide is added to the character after the balance patch so users can know which characters get changes.
A.I has improved to give you a more enjoyable play experience.
One notable change is that when the score difference is huge, A.I now forfeit the match.

notes.title: System Update : Ranked Mode Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/05a8c1f4133069d683202657f1e544810eff75c0.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[previewyoutube=AtxoCgzkg9o;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][System][/b]

[h3]1. Ranked Mode with Cross-Play
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/53048ebc6c10d39de3124fce31b5c7291dd5e5a1.png[/img]

2021’s first Ranked Mode is open now! Challenge your basketball soul, passion, and skill over the global users! This time cross-play is available with Ranked Mode

[b]1) Ranked Mode Change: Cross-play[/b]

-Cross-play selection option is now available. 

-Match option selection shortcut will be added to the Platform Only Ranked Mode line up page. Through this button, you can go to the setting page straightly but your current lineup will be broken.

-If you play Ranked Mode via cross-play, you will receive a 20% ranked point bonus when you win the game.

-For our first Ranked Mode with Cross-Play, all user will start at 1000 score. For next season, your start Rank will be determined your final Rank of previous season.

[b]2) Ranked Mode Change: Region[/b]

-Region is divided into 3 regions (NA/EU/Asia) for all platforms.

-Ranked Mode open time is varied by region. You can enter Ranked Mode only during the available time of your selected region.

-You can change your region by changing the matching server but your current Rank Score will reset. 

-Ranked Mode open hour is changed. Please check the timetable above.

[b]3) Ranked Mode Change: Rank[/b]

-You can now check your rank of all platform.

-Ranked mode match type does not affect your rank result.

-Your final rank and reward will be determined based on all platform rank of your region. 

-Since there will be more people joining Ranked Mode, score range for each tier and SSS Rank requirement is changed. Please check the table below.

[b][Score Range][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f58c7d54cb8137038cd3fc0bac8a6b4b53e8884b.png[/img]

[b][SSS Rank][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/938c857014e41b830b711b9cd382d50ae3ad1a1f.png[/img]

With cross-platform rank enabled, Ranked Mode will be tougher! Aim for the golden snow crystal trophy!

-Region is divided into 3 regions (NA/EU/Asia) for all platforms.
-You can now check your rank of all platform.

notes.title: Dev's Playbook : Year-End Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7558efe5ba622296c4e31a310e803985e9cb1ca1.png[/img]

Greetings from Dev team! 

We welcome all of you visiting FS CITY.

For this year, we sincerely appreciate your keen interest and love towards [b]<3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound>[/b]. To return your continuous interest, we are going to share our future update in advance, and try to interact with you.

[i][h2][b][End of Year New Contents Update][/b][/h2] [/i]

First of all, we would like to introduce the new content which all of the users are curious about.

[h3][b]1.	A new character, “Mika”[/b][/h3]
A new pop-idol character, “Mika” will join <3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound> as a Point Guard who has a new variety of pass skills. Also, you will definitely be the first pick by your teammates if you go with Mika as her skills are especially useful in giving buff to teammates. You may expect how a worldwide pop-idol Mika will play an important role in “West Fox”, “Big Flow”, and “Agent A”.

[h3][b]
2. A new court, “Fox Stadium”[/b][/h3]
A new court, “Fox Stadium” has come with the new character, “Mika”. For the next 3 weeks, you will play 3on3 mode exclusively in “Fox Stadium” and you will acquire a “Free. T concert ticket” once you complete your 3on3 match. “Free. T concert tickets” can be exchanged into ‘Free. T Girl Group Accessories,” “Intensive Manuals,” and other various items.

[i][h2][b]The future update of <3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound> 
in 2021[/b][/h2][/i]

2021 will be a prosperous year of <3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound>.
First of all, we are going to continuously release competition modes with our newly updated ‘Cross-platform’, such as Ranked mode, Ranked 3x3 mode, and Match Up mode. I already feel your passion towards being a high-ranker.

Secondly, we will add new Crew contents, and strengthen our community system which is our primary goal. We are also preparing a crew competition and a tournament between higher crews, which we think it would be a perfect chance for crew to show its true quality.

Furthermore, we promise to improve play environment on 3on3 FreeStyle by elaborately fixing and updating existing contents, continuously releasing new characters and making character balance better.
We guarantee our continuous updates to amuse you and hope we could all recover from 2020 and bring only greatness onto 2021! 

Happy new 2021 year!

Thank you.

-	3on3 Dev Team

notes.title: 12/07 System Update: Crossplay Update
notes.content:
Greetings, FS City,

The followings are the updates for this month.

[i][h1][b][System][/b][/h1][/i]

[u][h2][b]1. Cross Play Update[/b][/h2][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/65512ce9a7478fb6d81b47583969ab8de2320b1f.png[/img]

FS ballers’ most wanted update is here! Cross-Play is now available on 3on3 FreeStyle! It doesn’t matter which platform you play, you can play together whichever you are! Now let’s check how you can manage cross-play.

[h3][b]1) How cross-play will work[/b][/h3]
-Cross play is available on 3vs3 and 1vs1 mode
-If you allow cross-play, you can choose any server region to play

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/690d29c615b49629bc9d22a51bd8355f3aadd149.png[/img]

-If you select Steam Only, you can only choose server region supported by the platform

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/234467c14e588e5e4db3881ae371c60dd19c6b70.png[/img]
[h3]
[b]2) Cross-Play enable option[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/df89f30819367684897ee56f7d1fa56ed857630d.jpg[/img]

You can change your cross-play option on the option page
-Players from All Platform: you can be matched with other platform users
-Steam Only: you will be matched with Steam user only
-Your current cross-play enable setting can be checked on matching UI

[h3][b]3) Play together as Cross-Play[/b][/h3]
-If your current setting is “Players from All Platform], you can send invitation to your 3on3 friends regardless of their cross-play setting
-You cannot send invitation to other platform user if your cross-play setting is PlayStation Only
-If your current active setting is different with squad member, notice message will be shown
-Once you accept the message from users with different cross-play enable the option, your cross-play option will be temporarily changed until you leave the party

[h3][b]4) Cross-Play Q&A[/b][/h3]
[b]Q) How can I distinguish that another user is from a different platform?[/b]
A) Platform identifier is added next to the user’s ID. If the user is the same platform, you can see him with platform mark while Steam and other console platform are seen as PC and controller icon

[b]Q) Can I communicate with users from other platforms?[/b]
A) Unfortunately, we do not support a cross chat system. 

[b]Q) Should I have to play Cross-Play for the event?[/b]
A) No, cross-play is not required to enjoy current 3on3 content. It is an additional option, which helps you to match with other users easier and meet other players from different platforms.

[u][h2][b]2. Blacklist System Update[/b][/h2][/u]
Sometimes you want to avoid certain players. Blacklist system is added so you can block users with inappropriate behavior and manage the list from the social page

[h3][b]1) How Blacklist works [/b][/h3]	
-Once you block the user, all interactions with the blocked user is limited
-You cannot be in the same squad with a blocked user but you can be matched with him as the opponent
-You cannot invite or check the profile of the blocked user
-If you block your friend, he will be removed from your friend list and will be back once you remove him from your blacklist
-Blocked user will not know whether he is blocked by other users

[h3][b]2) How can I block the user?[/b][/h3]	
-After play match, you can block the user by using report system
-You can search user’s ID and block him on the social page

[u][h2][b]3. Server Change System[/b][/h2][/u]	
Want to play with your friend from other regions? No worries! Change your server region and switch freely! You can now change the server region whenever you want!

[h3][b]1) How to change server region[/b][/h3]	
-On the street map page, press the triangle button and select your favored server
-You can check the population and connection level
-Select the server region and go back to the street map. You can check your selected server at the bottom right corner
-If your current cross-play setting is a platform only, you can only select server region supported by your platform and client region

[i][h1][b][Events][/b][/h1][/i]

[u][h2][b]1.FS District Best Fashionista Event[/b][/h2][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2a734e9f7461bbb4718a5acaddda5b7eb175ad38.png[/img]

Who is FS District’s Fashionista? Show your today’s dress code to FS district!Pick your theme and match up your clothing. Post your dress code with the hashtag on SNS(Twitter and Facebook) and collect likes during the event period!

Top 5 most liked posts will go to the Final Round and the top 5 participants will receive the exclusive nametag and points!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ec81f9b10acab305b22fe53abb7e98c4a0a6f532.png[/img]

*Please aware that your entry will be eliminated if you do not satisfy the requirements even though you are in the top 5

You want to know the benefit of in the Top 5 participants, don’t you? If you are in the Top 5, you are guaranteed at least 100 points and exclusive Fashionista Nametag! During the final round, all FS ballers can vote for their favorite entry and rewards will be distributed based on your final rank!
Here is the reward list for Top 5 fashionistas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f8ae3f5d0ef659777d159544620e46bdd5423b80.png[/img]

[u][h2][b]2. Mission: Possible! Play Together[/b][/h2][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4fe36f23f8c1f3e169de1de82919877ea359724f.png[/img]

Play together, clear mission together, and enjoy together!
Challenge to the missions and get special reward! This time with enhanced rewards and exclusive together jersey & nametag!

[u][h2][b]3. CrossPlay Special Buff Balls Event[/b][/h2][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e0dfe03b986f8e2b0453045156f66d23b7a4d581.png[/img]

Update special exclusive buff ball is given to ALL Ballers!!! Just log in during 12/7 – 2021/1/12 23:59 PST! This buff ball is different from others! Check out the secret of the Together Buff Ball in the game right now!

[u][h2][b]4. Let’s Boom Up Together Facebook Follower/Likes Event[/b][/h2][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b60a64fc57f91b54826860c73364864e32747a2c.png[/img]

It’s time to boom up our Facebook community! Become a Facebook follower to get the most recent news and like our Facebook page to show your love! Once we reach certain numbers, a special gift will be sent to ALL FS Ballers!!

Reach 55k for the reward!
-Like 55k : Skill Training Ball x5
-Follower 55k : 10,000 coins

More reward if we reach 60k!
-Like 60k : Random Platinum Card Pack x3
-Follower 60k : Gold Card Pack Ticket x5

Reward will be sent to players who log in during 1/13 – 1/26 23:59 PST. So let’s dive into our Facebook Page!

notes.title: 10/28 System Update: New Features
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4d7d4cb9e9875e2fcbd324ad60454a7b84b9a9d8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]1. FreeStyle System[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5eb34859e3088318a31d4e885a4200cdfbca7ffb.png[/img]

Get some legendary moves and be as urban as you can be. We know by its title that this game is about Streetball but with this update, we may have crossed the boundary. I give you the most unprecedented, unexpected and unimaginable Freestyle!  

Navigate to Management, Freestyle and explore the Freestyle skills now. Find the best skills you could use based on your playstyle and character. Collect Freestyle pieces and complete the skill. Then you can move to Equip tab to wear the skills. Skills activates in the numbering order on the slots where you could switch your skills between slots as you wish.

Freestyle is more than just the look. Each Freestyle skill has its own buff like motion speed and defense resist.  You can upgrade these buffs by collecting more Pieces. 

[b]How do I collect the Pieces? [/b]

- It’s simple, you could purchase Freestyle packs to get random Pieces or you could find Piece tickets or Packs from Events.  Although, there’s only certain range of Freestyle you can get based on your character’s position. 

Check all the available Freestyle for your position on Piece Shop!

[b]So it’s more or less similar to Card Packs, although, what is the Black Pack?[/b]

- This package instantly opens 1 Freestyle skill. Simply choose a shot you want for your Freestyle and you will get a random Freestyle Pieces ready to combine straightaway. You can only open it once per an account.

[b]What if I have Pieces that I would never need? [/b]

- You can sell the Pieces and get Piece tickets in return. You can use these Tickets to exchange other Pieces for Freestyle skill you want from Piece Shop.

[b]How can I use the skills? [/b]

- Pop the Activation order page by pressing down button on the Equip page and you can see each skill is assigned to different categories like Jump shot, Short distance layup and etc. With this, you would know how to pull off. 

[b]Would I be able to activate Freestyle with Character’s exclusive skill? [/b]

- Character’s skill will activate prior to Freestyle. Let’s think of Lee’s Skill ‘Signature Shot’, where he shoots with his signature move when wide open. His signature move will activate first then Freestyle follows. 

[b]I can’t seem to pull off Double Clutch or Lay-up pass. [/b]

- Skills that activates while trying shooting won’t activate when Freestyle is in action. 

[b]Can I get a long distance Dunk Freestyle for my Kim?[/b]

- Dunk is definitely a shared skill so I wouldn’t say you can’t. but let’s say, your character does more jump shot than dunk, you want to collect Jump shot Freestyle than others. 


[h3][b]2. Pet System[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7cc7f89973649497693570ebef2746e18a24a83b.png[/img]

The cutest and the most powerful addition is here. Get a Pet and give a big boost to your game! 

First step is to adopt a Pet! Move to Shop, Pet menu. And select how rare you want to go for. Better the rarity, easier in activating the effect and better the effect you can get! 

When you have purchased a Pet, move to Management, Pet. Type in its name and select your Main or any character you own that needs buffs.  Then you will see your pet being tagged with a Character. Careful as you will need to spend Points to break the bond with your Pet.

[b][Manage Pet : Prestige][/b]

Let your stress lifted to activate buffs. Prestige is all about how easier you want to activate your Skill. 

Although, Max. Level you could reach varies by your Pet’s Rarity. Max cap for Pet Prestige is the following.

As you climb up the ladder, you will find your Condition to activate your buff gets easier! 

Q: I have this Condition say ‘[Enemy Team] Shot Success 5 Times’ I want to change my Condition that I can control. 

A: No, you can’t I’m afraid. Only way to change your Condition is having another Pet! I recommend raising your Prestige as you will find out the Condition is not as bad as it looks!

[b][Manage Pet : Skill][/b]

This is where your Pet really shines. Skill and stat is random when you pull a Pet. Although, you have higher max in Stat and better set of Skills in the following order; Platinum, Gold, Silver and Bronze. Draw your best suit using Skill Change Ticket! If you max your Prestige with Good Skill, you could make it like your next Passive Skill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/68cfccd173dbef318e91a3832ed08b23c83dab6f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/68f84f7b62d7f3bbe29331929d9d3cefdb59eeef.png[/img]

[b][Manage Pet : Friendship][/b]

Build a strong Friendship with your Pet and farm your Pet coin! Run 3on3 matches with your Pet and raise your Friendship! Take this following chart in mind and get the most of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d0ce857b0c86078271a7096f39b34968440ba97b.png[/img]

When you reach a certain mark, you get 1 Pet Coin. One max Friendship gauge could give you 6 Pet Coin and you can start over again! 

[b]Q: Would I lose my progress in Friendship when I break a bond and pair with another Character?[/b]
A: No, you won’t. You can keep your Friendship as long as you have the Pet.

[b][Manage Pet : Appearance][/b]

Like the buff, like how it activates but don’t like the look? Change Pet’s look to any Pets in your Inventory! 

Everything else stays. Pet could turn into any Pet you have opened. 

[b]Q: I want to turn my Drone into Corgi but I have accidentally deleted Corgi from my inventory.[/b]
A: Once you have pulled Corgi from a Pack, you can change its look to Corgi no matter you have the Corgi or not. Consider opening the Pet as unlocking a look!

[b][Extra Q&A][/b]

[b]Q: What happens if I dismiss a Pet? Would I get Coins like when selling Outfit?[/b]
A: If you permanently dismiss a Pet from Inventory, you get some Pet Coin in return. 10 Pet Coin for Platinum Pet, 4 for Gold, 2 for Silver and 1 for Bronze.
[b]Q: I have 6 Corgis in the court, is there a way I could not see these pet?[/b]
A: Sure thing! Change your setting to only view my pets or make them all invisible in the Option Menu.


[h3][b]3. Preset System[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e6f2def05a2edaa57625e1343705e732d43ab55b.png[/img]

Set your BEST Card Combinations in your Preset!

Now you can save your card combination and change whenever you want!

Here is the ultimate guide of how you can use this new system!

[b][How to Set Preset][/b]

-You can set each preset under the Ability Card page
-Preset will be automatically saved once you finish equipping the card for each preset
-Each character can have up to 3 presets

[b][How can I use Preset][/b]

-Preset’s ability card status will be applied during the match
-By default, the character’s first preset will be selected automatically


[h3][b]4. Position Filter[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/50825dc22caacbda9ad2bc7548812051a71787b0.png[/img]

Position Filter system now allows you to select your character easier and faster!

Your last played character will be selected as default for the next line up.


[h3][b]5. Mileage System[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/abd37ef4752de1dc8190bf341557c3878699f9a5.png[/img]

A new system comes to satisfy all the shopping bag lovers! Stack your Mileage with your purchase on Costume Shopping Bag and get a Mileage ticket to open a Mileage bag. This Mileage bag has a full set of exclusive outfit! Stand out amongst all costume fanatics(fans) and believe me, this Charming Devil Dress Sets alone could do the trick! Here’s how you could get Mileage Shopping bags!

[b][How to participate in the event][/b]

You get 3~4% mileage per each purchase of any outfit shopping bags.

*Newly Updated Shopping Bag : Raise 3% for each purchase
*Previously Updated Shopping Bag : Raise 4% for each purchase
Once you have 100% mileage, you will get a Mileage Ticket!

notes.title: 10/8 Update: New Events and Items
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7fd95d54fbd942160ac3238cd3c6003cfa3b26cb.png[/img]

Greetings FS City Ballers,

The following are the events that will be available to the game starting today!

[b][h3]1. Deacon aka Out of Control Update[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3b22d1da765f5d258b702ef934828025a87ed624.png[/img]

The toughest and wildest player join the court! Deacon, aka Out of Control, has beast-like skills 
to tackle the opponent and rule the ground.

This tough legend comes with a unique berserk mode called Rage. Plus, check out 3 new active skills

[b][h3]1) Rage (P1 Skill) ​
[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e852676f6f1572e9db5d8f089d85904f2afc0a34.png[/img]

- 3 successful Rebound auto-activates Rage mode. 

- Stat Increase

  On Rage, Dash stamina cost reduces by 30%

  Rebound stat increase by 5 

- Skill Increase

  Post Push gets faster, making easier to secure Rebound position at the right timing.  

  Shoulder Charge gets stronger. With each successful Shoulder Charge on Rage, Loose ball

  chance increase.

  Inside Tackle is easier to use with shorter Cool downtime.

[h3][b]2) Post Push (P3 Skill) ​
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2d8d59e968acd3962ac7821100a51197aa05bf0b.png[/img]

This skill gives reckless push to opponent to secure the best inside-position for rebound
 both on defense and offense. 

Skill activates to opponent close to the basket.

[h3][b]3)  Shoulder Charge (P4 Skill)
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/475f56e05d9723c8762cf2328c3f0dd67752ed98.png[/img]

Strong drive right in the face of the opponent. This skill stuns the opponent for a bit and has a 
chance to make a loose ball when the opponent has the ball. 

[h3][b]4. Inside Tackle (P5 Skill​)
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f99d132aa3fd2f37aabd4073d9de202d3afb9c49.png[/img]

Ultimate skill to sabotage a team play. Deacon grabs and falls over on the opponent stunning
 both himself and the opponent if successful. 

Activates in all area.

[h3][b]5) Fling Down (P5 Passive) 
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/722691e4a0f63b7d4b04549e26692536fcb8b247.png[/img]

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6d0938be3fd75d735f70d00a1bee07373c7dcdd9.jpg[/img]

Welcome the new legends, more strategically developed for a team play. And for nerfed Characters, it is not just a setback but a necessary change for a fair play as we believe 3on3 FreeStyle match should shine when together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0dd967ada623dcc89a3fcf60fbeb9a2264ac90b6.png[/img]

Carolina could penetrate her way to basket but her score was a big letdown.
 We have raised her shot skill and be the decider of the game.
-       Short Distance Layup stat increased from 140 to 165 (P5 Lv.10 based)
-       Floater Defense Resist increased by 3 times. 0.36%/0.54% → 1.08%/1.62%
-       Floater Success rate increased by 1.5 times. 1.6%/3.6% → 2.4% / 5.2%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1d577b895e86cba1eba1a2988fd47a44dc23ceb3.png[/img]

He is meant to be the effortless scorer but couldn’t make a score even when open wide. We have changed him to be the number 1 recruit list.

-      3 Point Shot success rate increased
-      Shot Fake Stamina cost reduced by 50%
-      Fade away success rate increased 1.2%/1.6%/2.4%/2.4% → 2.4%/3.2%/4.8%/4.8%
-      Quick Jumper success rate increased 0.6%/0.8%/1.2%/1.2% → 1.2%/1.6%/2.4%/2.4%
-      Front Untamed Dash Stat increased 1.2cm/1.2cm/1.8cm/1.8cm → 1.2cm/1.8cm/1.8cm/2.4cm
-      Front Untamed Dash Animation speed increased and Stamina cost reduced

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cfee8b8537f4d13fa348dc05b2d329c7110c6d64.png[/img]

This fun to play character has a lot to offer but his kill moves didn’t seem that effective. Note this change and find his potential against shooters!

-       P5 Speed Block Distance and Success rate increased
-       Tip in stat increased 3%/4%/6%/6% → 4%/5%/7%/7%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ac69a983092c9deac976511f0bbad560b4843a7f.png[/img]

All time legend Joey is meant to hang in mid-range but his 3point shot was a frustration for schemer. 
We have changed him so that he could not just play idle but really engage into the game.

-       3 Point Shot Stat reduced 140 → 127(P5 lv.10 based)
-       Double Clutch costs Stamina
-       Rebound Stat increased 114 → 127(P5 lv.10 based)
-       Short Distance Dunk stat increased 114 → 127(P5 lv.10 based)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fbc2f168e12bfc9f6da2cfaf8dfb071f36ee6520.png[/img]

Murdock could go a long way with his shot and awed us all. With this change, he could find a right competition that matches his position.

-       Mid Shot Stat reduced 76 → 63(P5 lv.10 based)
-       3 Point Shot Animation Speed reduced
-       Short Distance Dunk Stat increased 127 → 140 (P5 lv.10 based)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/bcbe0f5a9b8b7c842664cfcfddc1ad130eff30d4.png[/img]

She is a keeper for players with bigs but her P5 was not working well. Now she got her P5 skill back with new ability. Check out how much stamina you could save with Christa!

notes.title: 09/29 System Update: New Features and Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/60bfa4ff4da12de6de39f53929da28ab5b219843.jpg[/img]

Greetings FS City Ballers,

Check out below the new features and mode that will be added to the game starting today.

[h3][b]1. Practice With Jefferson[/b][/h3]

Practice various skills with Jefferson whenever you want!

Now you can do 1vs1 Practice with Jefferson and improve your control Skills!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8a6b733b512322c15d402fbf9a1fcb74b7316dc4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/64cefe144d52bb7bcb69ec15e6f2bcb6c06a99af.jpg[/img]

- There is no Shot Clock Violation, Score Limitation, or Time Limit in practice mode! Practice as you will!

- You can check your shot gauge, character stamina, and shot information while practicing

- You can practice different characters by Change Character options. Press N and pick your character

- Jefferson can be your side or the opponent. Press M to change Jefferson’s team and practice offense and defense skills freely!

- You can pop up the skill list and check your character’s skills

- If you input the command correctly, the activated skill will be highlighted

[h3][b]2. Free Mode Update[/b][/h3]

More customization options are updated in Free Mode! Customize your personal match and experience different situations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a280d6dfad907bd94b282fd92428f117ba2d7b09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8f2e067b99a77c8da444a549862cfd30f150bb97.jpg[/img]

-You can change the court type. Pick your favorite court whenever you want!

-You can change ground rule. Try 3vs3, 3vs2, 3vs1, 2vs2, 2vs1, 1vs1, and so on

-You can change A.I difficulty level, ground rules, and game timer

[h3][b]3. Challenge Mode Update[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7dd739fa338a7b29a6880b209916d5abc9dcedfb.png[/img]

Challenge your skills and be the top ballers! Challenge Mode is a system designed to allow players to play with different rules and conditions unlike regular game, so that they can feel new and various fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d1cf04d95ffa4af8e835b760f0ebbc5ac6007cdb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7989abac6de7c3054fcca9843b903a84c866c881.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/efeaa3a3f9a54c4262fa77b01c046323bcd13e42.jpg[/img]

-In Challenge Mode, you can try [Rebound] / [Block] / [Jump Shot] missions and receive rewards by clearing the missions

- The higher the level of mission difficulty, the opponent AI’s ability improves and clear condition becomes more difficult

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/dbf89ea164524b3bf0afa2eea729e73cf9a537d5.jpg[/img]

-Based on your Challenge Mode score you will receive monthly Challenge Mode ranking reward

[h3][b]4. Buff System Update[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c08b5c70a8b0e4e297a5f435340653b994e8cd94.png[/img]

Be an expert in your position!  Your characters can share buffs with the group in the same position. 
You can have as many as 8 buffs. Find out what it’s about and how you can best take advantage of this new feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c6d0215d1b0f7e997e3321b4b7b82112533bceaa.png[/img]

-Navigate to P-buff on Management and assign a character to a slot

-Add a buff on Position buff 1 and a random buff from the list on the right would come up

-Move to the other character of same position to check if he got the buff

[b]Q&A[/b]

[b][i]1) Are the buffs different by characters?[/i][/b]
: Yes, they are. Browse through characters on P-Buff page and check the lists of buffs.

[b][i]2) How can I unlock the rest of the slots and Position Buff 2?[/i][/b]
: Unlock the 3rd at lv.10 and 4th at lv.20. Position Buff 2 is available when the character you’ve assigned is P5.

[b][i]3) Can Buff 1 and Buff 2 have the same buff?[/i][/b]
: Yes, the same buff can come up twice and give you a double effect! 

[b][i]4) Does the stat change by Prestige?[/i][/b]
: Yes, when your character in the slot have higher Prestige, you get better buff.

[b][i]5) Can’t I choose buff from the list?[/i][/b]
: I’m afraid you can’t, although, you can change your buff to another random from the list by using Buff Change Ticket.

[h3][b]5.Food Buff System[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/58a2803cdfabac055f47324f2e18589c79d4bad1.png[/img]

Eat up and get buffed for your game! 

Make your own freshly cooked meal and get the best buff that could complete your main players.

Here’s all you need to know about the new Buff System.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3345001aa2ed8a2ab3e3e7401c4e5fc0b0480d7a.jpg[/img]

Go the Management and find the Food Truck tab!

[Get Your Ingredients!]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/576c3f7ad81d932251d2eb188ded1ad23bc5a820.png[/img]

Get Free or Purchase them from Shop 

- Free Loot Boxes have Cool down but leveling up these Boxes would do the trick! 

-Reduce your Cool time and increase Max acquirable boxes by leveling up.

-Level up all the way to 9 and stack up your Loot Boxes to 50 whilst you are away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fc5edfaa695a290b0dfeb126f90b823a658bedef.png[/img]

-Can’t wait for Cool down? Get them immediately as much as you want from shop!

[Cooking Time!]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/47e1616bdc9739058705cc30374e8a505a2f246d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/732df64c6eb0d443f7ba8b228996015d01c11b84.png[/img]

Get Free food for small buff or purchase Recipe for Big Buff!

-As for Special Food, you have to purchase Recipes to cook! Cooking will consume 1 Recipe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/df021575c60e9c37edaf82de1f4fdba00154070a.png[/img]

-Consume the food before the match start and get food buff during match!

[h3][b]6. Big Flow Update[/b][/h3]

Check out the newly added legendary court, Big Flow court! This is the court where freestyle basketball was born in the beginning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4a98b31a44b306de6efb45bf2282fe0d290ac900.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/416313a94fd437ffabad605e3281f5b26b50c255.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/864f0664b63159dda735f34884631293716d1c31.png[/img]

[Big Flow Express Event]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/103fd68af6aec071825730207988c84eb5764b16.png[/img]

Take a railway trip with Big Flow! Update special, enjoy the vent full of exclusive rewards.

Complete Weekly and Daily Missions to collect Rail Tickets and exchange them with rewards that could only be found in them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9a477da4a48d3476ddd52bcaf576265f1b107912.jpg[/img]

Each week, the event offers different Mission set and Rewards. Check what it is and make sure you don’t miss a thing!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/153c66d762ecd4f6511e9f3e4c2a4ec9ad489d41.png[/img]

You can exchange rail tickets to various items.

notes.title: System Update: New Features and Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4c597c7bc2a8912fcac64ffd5e5bf0ba67a528a5.png[/img]

Greetings FS City Ballers,

Check out below the new features and mode that will be added to the game starting today.

[h3][b]1. Practice Mode Update[/b][/h3]

Having trouble catching up with Skills? Don’t you worry as you could enter and practice all the necessary skills in Practice mode with our helpful Rabbit man, Jefferson! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/14633064ee157e1148d4af3ae138171e9eb63473.png[/img]

Check out the New mode and get Coin Rewards as well! 

[h3][b]2. MVP Scene Update[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/344af82db61acb1f0505c6e72bdefca9435d9bd7.png[/img]

Make your moment special with your own MVP Scenes and share yours with others.

These character exclusive MVP scenes are made for your mains. 

Find the first MVP Scene update on Management page. 

All characters will be having default MVP scenes plus! There are available Exclusive MVP Scene for Carter, Helena, Cindy, Kim, Joey, Lulu!

[h3][b]3.In-Game Chat System[/b][/h3]

Now you can communicate with your teammates through the in-game chat system! Chat panel is added to the lineup page. There are two chat channels: team channel and all channel. In the "Team channel", you can communicate with your teammates during line up and the match. You can chat with your opponent during the match on "All channel". To keep clean chat behavior, there will be a prevention system to those whom having inappropriate chat behavior.

[h3][b]4.In-Game Friend System [/b][/h3]

Add 3on3 users as your friend whenever you want! You can find the Friend tab in the SOCIAL page, which can be found on the top right corner in the main lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d2da226b9d238af8328b7303dc7634c94408f100.png[/img]

On the [Friend List] tab, you can see your “3on3 Friend”. 3on3 Friend is a friend you send requests through the game regardless of the platform. You can also check your Steam platform friend under the [Steam Friend] tab. You can see your Steam friend’s Steam profile by selecting the [Profile] button. You can manage your received and sent friend requests up to 20 people per section under the [Friend Request] tab. In this tab, you can accept or decline the friend request or cancel your sent friend request. Make sure to have enough space; if your lists are full, you cannot receive or send the friend requests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fd95bb76b2d63d53a9e5d542b70668542d1949e1.png[/img]

What if you want to add your friend before or without playing a game together? You can send a friend request by searching the user’s name in [Search Friend] tab. You have to input the correct nickname to find the user.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d4b9757a063b5efd01cf9e7dcb4d3d29bd8c9dcc.png[/img]
